sa: ज्ञेयाः सर्वे च वृत्तान्ता भरतस्येङ्गितानि च। तत्त्वेन मुखवणेन दृष्ट्या व्याभाषितेन च॥
en: You should know, from the colour of his countenance, his looks and his words, all the movements and actions of Bharata.

sa: अमोघं दर्शनं राम तवास्माकं नरर्षभ। प्रीतियुक्ताः स्म तेन त्वं ब्रूहि यन्मनसेप्सितम्॥
en: O Rama,Oforemost of men, this our presence here, must not be fruitless, we are pleased-do you ask for what you wish.

sa: कश्चिन्मे त्वत्समो नास्ति सौहृदेन बलेन च। गच्छ शत्रुवधाय त्वं कुम्भकर्णजयाय च॥
en: Like you have I none either in friendship or strength. Therefore, O Kumbhakama, go for destroying the foe and securing celebrity.

sa: तेन नादेन महता पृथिवी समकम्पत। तं शब्दं सहसा श्रुत्वा वानरा दुद्रुवुर्भयात्॥
en: With his tremendous roar the earth shook. And hearing all on a sudden that sound, the monkeys fled away in fear.

sa: हनूमन् दूरमध्वानं कथं मां नेतुमिच्छसि। तदेव खलु ते मन्ये कपित्वं हरियूथप॥
en: Hanumān, how darest you take me to such a long distance? O lord of monkey hosts, this attests to your monkey-hood.

sa: स तैः परिवृतः शूरैः सर्वतः स महाबलः। आससादायसं भीमं परिघं तोरणाश्रितम्॥
en: Environed on all sides by those heroes, that exceedingly powerful one, staying by the main entrance, look up a terrific bolt.

sa: तेन सृष्टा महावेगाः शराः सर्पविषोपमाः। संप्राप्य लक्ष्मणं पेतुः श्वसन्त इव पनगाः॥
en: And discharged by him, those exceedingly impetuous arrows, resembling the venom of serpents, hitting Laksmana, fell down like to hissing snakes.

sa: हर्षेण महता युक्तः सीतादर्शनजेन सः। हृदयेन गतो राम लक्ष्मणं च सलक्षणम्॥
en: And experiencing rapture in consequence of his seeing Sītä, he mentally presented himself before Rāma, and Lakşmaņa graced with auspicious marks.

sa: वैदेह्या वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षस्यो विदूता दुतम्। स्थिताः काश्चिद्गताः काश्चिद् रावणाय निवेदितुम्॥
en: Hearing Vaidehi's words, the Raksasis swiftly took to their heels. Some remained, and some departed to inform Rāvana of the matter.

sa: सैन्यं तु विद्रुतं दृष्ट्वा धूम्राक्षो राक्षसर्षभः। रोषेण कदनं चक्रे वानराणां युयुत्सताम्॥
en: Seeing the forces fleeing away, that foremost of Raksasas-Dhumraksa-flying into fury, began a terrific conflict with the monkeys desirous of encounter.

sa: राक्षसस्य सखित्वं च भवद्भिः सह रोचते। अविभक्ताश्च सर्वार्थाः सुहृदां नात्र संशयः॥
en: Do you therefore turn your minds to making friendship with the Rākşasas. All interests are forsooth the common possession of friends.

sa: वाग्भि शं रावणतर्जिता च। कान्तारमध्ये विजने विसृष्टा बालेव कन्या विललाप सीता॥
en: Threatened by Rāvana and encircled by the Rākşasīs, that timid damsel bewailed like a girl cast off in a lonely forest.

sa: अवधूय च ता बुद्धिं बभूवावस्थितस्तदा। जगाम चापरां चिन्तां सीतां प्रति महाकपिः॥
en: Then resigning that line of thought, that mighty monkey, regaining his equanimity, set out in another direction of thought touching Sītā.

sa: तं दुमाणां शिलानां च वर्ष प्राणहरं महत्। व्यापोहत महातेजा रावणिः समितिजय॥
en: That destroyer of foes—the exceedingly energetic son to Rāvaņa resisted that mighty shower of trees and stones capable of compassing destruction.

sa: तं न पश्याम्यहं युद्धे योऽद्य रामं सलक्ष्मणम्।। नाशयेत्सबलं वीरं ससुग्रीवं विभीषणम्।९।।
en: Him see I not that can now slay Rāma with Lakşmaņa, that hero together with his forces and Sugrīva and Vibhīşana.

sa: बाहुभ्यां संप्रयुध्यस्व यदि मे द्वन्द्वमाहवे। वेगं सहस्व दुर्बुद्धे ततस्त्वं रक्षसां वरः॥
en: If in the encounter, you bear my impetus, then, O you of perverse sense, you indeed are the foremost of Rākşasas.

sa: दुमाणां च शिलानां च शस्त्राणां चापि निस्वनः। श्रूयते सुमहांस्तत्र घोरो हृदयभेदनः॥
en: There were heard sounds of trees and rocks and weapons, mighty and dreadful and capable of striking terror into the heart.

sa: अथ सौम्य दशग्रीवो मृगयां याति राघवे। लक्ष्मणे चापि निष्क्रान्ते प्रविवेशाश्रमं तदा॥
en: O gentle one, Räghava going out on hunting, and Lakṣmaṇa having issued out of the hermitage, the Ten-necked (demon) entered therein.

sa: अक्षतं जातरूपं च गावः कन्याः सहद्विजाः। नरा मोदकहस्ताश्च रामस्य पुरतो ययुः॥
en: Persons with Aksata and gold in their hands, kine, girls, Brāhmaṇas and persons with Modaka in their hands went before Rāma.

sa: स हि मायाबलः क्रूरो रावणः शत्रुरावणः। मां मोहयति दुष्टात्मा पीतमात्रेव वारुणी॥
en: That guileful and wicked-minded one, Rāvana, destroyer of enemies, having powers of illusion, overwhelms me even as the Vāruni just drunk.

sa: तस्य सूतस्तदा दिव्यमुपस्थाप्य महारथम्। स्थितः स च महातेजा अध्यारोहत तं रथम्॥
en: Thereat the charioteer brought the noble and mighty car and stood (there) and then that exceeding energetic one mounted the car.

sa: ते संप्रहृष्टा हरयो भीमानुद्यम्य पादपान्। आकाशं विविशुः सर्वे मार्गमाणा दिशो दश॥
en: Thereat with alacrity those monkeys, wielding mighty trees, shot up into the sky, and began to scour the ten cardinal points.

sa: न तदग्निशिखा कुर्यात् संस्पृष्टा पाणिना सती। जनकस्य सुता कुर्याद् यत् क्रोधकलुषीकृता॥
en: Even the flame of fire cannot do, although touched by the hands, what Janaka's daughter can bring about by her ire.

sa: रक्षसा तेन रोषाच्च भुजानां पीडनात्तथा। मुक्तो विरावः सहसा त्रैलोक्यं येन कम्पितम्।।२९
en: The Rākṣasa, from wrath and the pain felt in his arms, set up a shout that shook the entire triune world.

sa: त्रयाणामेव भूतानां सागरस्येह लङ्घने। शक्तिः स्याद् वैनतेयस्य तव वा मारुतस्य वा॥
en: In all the three worlds, Vinata's offspring, your self, and the Wind-god, have talone the power of crossing over the deep.

sa: यदा क्षयं गतं सर्वं तदा विष्णुर्महाबलः। असृतं सोऽहरत् तूर्णं मायामास्थाय मोहिनीम्॥
en: And when a great havoc had been committed the highly powerful Vişņu, assuming a captivating form speedily stole away the ambrosia.

sa: वीरेणाहं तथानेन त्वया चापि यशस्विनि। प्रत्याख्याता न जीवामि सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: O illustrious lady, if forsaken by this hero and yourself I shall not live any longer, I tell you this truly.

sa: समयश्च मया पूर्वं कृतो वै शत्रुकर्शन। नाहं युधि नियोक्तव्यो नाप्याचार्यः कथंचन॥
en: O Grinder of foes, I have made arrangements with you that, neither myself nor the preceptor Drona shall survive this war.

sa: न तवाविदितं किंचिन्मां तु जिज्ञासते भवान्। पृष्टेन चापि वक्तव्यमेष धर्मः सनातनः॥
en: Nothing is unknown to you. Still you ask me. One, however, who is questioned, should answer. This is the eternal practice.

sa: उवाच चैनम्-'वत्सोत्तङ्क, किं ते प्रियं करवाणि' इति। धर्मतो हि शुश्रूषितोऽस्मि भवता। तेन प्रीतिः परस्परेण नौ संवृद्धा। तदनुजाने भवन्तम्, सर्वानेव कामानवाप्स्यसि, गम्यताम् इति॥
en: He said, “Uttanka, my child, what favour may I bestow on you? I have been properly and faithfully served by you. Our friendship for each other has, therefore, increased. I grant you permission to go. Depart and let your wishes be fulfilled."

sa: वसतो दण्डकारण्ये तापसान् धर्मचारिणः। किं नु हत्वा महाभागान् फलं प्राप्स्यसि राक्षस॥
en: What, O Rākṣasa, do you gain by slaughtering exceedingly pious ascetics engaged in righteous acts, living in the forest of Dandaka?

sa: संजय उवाच कृतवर्मा कृपो द्रौणिः सूतपुत्रश्च मारिष। उलूकः सौबलश्चैव राजा च सह सोदरैः॥ सीदमानां चमूं दृष्ट्वा पाण्डुपुत्रभयार्दिताम्। समुहुः स्म वेगेन भिन्नां नावमिवार्णवे॥
en: Sanjaya said Beholding the Kuru army afflicted with the fear of Pandu's son sinking like a boat foundered in the ocean, Kritavarma, Kripa, Drona's son, Suta's son, Ulaka, Subala's son Shakuni and the king himself with his brother, came to their rescue.

sa: अहो शाखामृगत्वं ते व्यक्तमेव प्लवङ्गम। लघुचित्ततयात्मानं न स्थापयसि यो मतौ।। ।॥
en: O monkey-chief, truly manifest is your monkey-hood and it is through your lightheartedness that you are incapable of fixing your soul.

sa: ते कृता विमुखाः सर्वे मत्प्रयुक्तैः शिलाशितैः। ततो मातलिना तूर्णं हयास्ते सम्प्रचोदिताः॥
en: (And) I drove them back by those arrows of mine sharpened on stones. Then those horses being swiftly driven by Matali,

sa: स ददर्शासने रामो विषण्णं पितरं शुभे। कैकेय्या सहितं दीनं मुखेन परिशुष्यता॥
en: Rāma saw his father, seated on a beautiful sofa with Kaikeyi, looking sorry and poorly and with his countenance dried up.

sa: न चिरं पापकर्माणः क्रूरा लोकजुगुप्सिताः। ऐश्वर्यं प्राप्य तिष्ठन्ति शीर्णमूला इव द्रुमाः।७।।
en: Like to trees whose roots have been reduced, cruel persons, execrated of men, who perpetrate iniquitous acts, do not exist long.

sa: नाहं परकृतं दोषं त्वय्याधास्ये कथंचन। यथासुखं वै जीव त्वं प्राणानवसृजामि ते॥
en: I will never attribute the faults, committed by others, to you. Indeed, do you live happily. I grant you your life.

sa: आगमिष्यति बीभत्सुरिमां द्वारवतीं पुरीम्॥ आख्येयं तस्य यद् वृत्तं वृष्णीनां वैशसं महत्।
en: Vibhatsa will come to this city, viz., Dvaravati. Tell him what has taken place viz., this great destruction of the Vrishnis.

sa: विभीषणस्य च तथा सफलोऽद्य परिश्रमः। विगुणं भ्रातरं त्यक्त्वा यो मां स्वयमुपस्थितः।।।।
en: Today also the labour of Vibhişaņa has borne fruit-who renouncing his brother, devoid of all good Qualities, came to my side.

sa: श्रुत्वा च निनदं घोरं पाण्डवानां जयैषिणाम्॥ अनुसारभयाद् भीताः प्राङ्मुखाः प्राद्रवन् पुनः।
en: Hearing the loud noise set up by the victorious Pandavas, they feared a pursuit and therefore fled towards the east. were

sa: मलयं दर्दुरं चैव ततः स्वेदनुदोऽनिलः। उपस्पृश्य ववौ युक्त्या सुप्रियात्मा सुखं शिवः॥
en: And then touching Malaya and Dardura, and laden (with perfumes), a delicious and welcome wind began to blow delightfully, removing sweat.

sa: देव्युवाच सुप्राकृतोऽपि पुरुषः सर्वः स्त्रीजनसंसदि। स्तौति गवार्यते चापि स्वमात्मानं न संशयः॥
en: The goddess said Persons of even ordinary powers applaud themselves and brag before their wives. There is no doubt in this.

sa: जित्वा परस्वमाहृत्य राज्यं वा यदि वा बसु। प्रतिपाणः प्रदातव्यः परमोधर्म उच्यते॥
en: To stake back other's possessions, that is, wealth and kingdom, that are already won, is said to be the chief virtue.

sa: विक्रमं च प्रशंसन्ति क्षत्रियस्य विशाम्पते। स्वको हि धर्मः शूराणां विक्रमः पार्थिवर्षभ॥
en: O king, prowess is always admired in a Kshatriya. O best of kings, prowess is the cardinal virtue of the heroes.

sa: न स्मराम्यनृतं ह्युक्तं न च हिंसां स्मराम्यहम्। सर्वेषां प्राणिनां पापं न स्मरामि कदाचन।७।। केनाद्य दुष्कृतेनायं बाल एव ममात्मजः। अकृत्वा पितृकार्याणि गतो वैवस्वतक्षयम्॥
en: I do not remember to have ever uttered a falsehood, or injured an animal or perpetrated any other crime. Therefore for some other sinful action, this boy, without performing the son's duties towards his parents, has gone to the abode of death.

sa: कच्चित् तेऽपि निरातङ्का वसन्ति विषये तव। कच्चिद् वर्तसि पौराणी वृत्तिं राजर्षिसेविताम्॥
en: Are those also who live in your kingdom frce from fear? Do you follow the old and traditional conduct of kings?

sa: भीष्मं प्रमुखतः कृत्वा प्रययौ सह सेनया। भीष्मं तु रथवंशेन दृष्ट्वा समभिसंवृतम्।।५०।
en: Placing Bhishma at the van proceeded to battle, surrounded by the troops. Beholding Bhishma thoroughly encompassed by a host of cars,

sa: सतां मतमतिक्रम्य योऽसतां वर्तते मते। शोचन्ते व्यसने तस्य सुहृदो न चिरादिव॥
en: The friends of him, who disregarding the opinions of the honest, follows that of dishonest men, soon grave at his distress,

sa: प्रविशन्नेव च श्रीमान् राघवो भवनं पितुः। ददर्श पितरं दूरात् प्रणिपत्य कृताञ्जलिः॥
en: And immediately on entering his father's residence, the graceful Rāghava seeing his father from a distance, bent low with clasped hands.

sa: ततश्व तं बली भीष्मः प्रगृह्म विपुलं भुजम्। उद्यन्मेघस्वरो वाग्मी काले वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: The mighty Bhishma then, taking the strong hand of Yudhishthira, addressed hiin, in a voice deep as that of the clouds.

sa: मद्बलेन विरुद्धाय न स्याद् दैवबलं तथा। प्रभविष्यति दुःखाय यथोग्रं पौरुषं मम॥
en: Influence of destiny shall not bring my opponents that amount happiness, as the misery inflicted on them by my terrible prowess.

sa: ततः संस्तूय गोविन्दं कथयित्वा च पाण्डवः। आश्वास्य ताः स्त्रियश्चापि मातुलं द्रष्टुमभ्यगात्॥
en: Praising Govinda and talking with the ladies, the son of Pandu comforted them and then proceeded to see his maternal uncle.

sa: ततस्ते भ्रातरः पञ्च शरैर्विद्धा महात्मना। परिवार्य रणे वीरं विव्यधुः सायकै शम्॥
en: Thereupon those five brothers pierced by the arrows of that high-souled one, surrounding the hero, wounded him soon with their arrows.

sa: प्रविश्य वदनं राहोर्यः सोमं पिबते निशि। ग्रसत्यर्कं च स्वर्भानुभूत्वा मां सोऽभिरक्षतु॥
en: Let him who entering Rahu's mouth drinks Soma in the night and who becoming Svarbhanu devours the Sun also, protect me.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः कन्यासहस्रेण वृता शिबिकया तदा। पितुर्नियोगात् त्वरिता निश्चक्राम पुरोत्तमात्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been commanded by her father, Sharmishtha with one thousand maidens came out of her father's excellent palace.

sa: अर्जुनं वासुदेवं च यौ तौ लोकोऽभिमन्यते। तावेतौ सहितावेहि खाण्डवस्य समीपतः॥ तौ त्वं याचस्व साहाय्ये दाहार्थं खाण्डवस्य च। ततो धक्ष्यसि तं दावं रक्षितं त्रिदशैरपि॥
en: They are called on earth Vasudeva (Krishna) and Arjuna. They are now staying near the Khandava (forest). Ask those two (heroes) to help you in consuming the Khandava. You will then be able to consume it, even if it be protected by the celestial.

sa: कालात् स भगवान् विष्णुर्यस्य सर्वमिदं जगत्। नादिर्न मध्यं नैवान्तस्तस्य देवस्य विद्यते॥
en: The Divine Vishnu, who is identical with this universe, is superior to Time. That god is without beginning, middle, and end.

sa: न च प्रीणयते चक्षुः सदा दुर्योधनस्य सः। क्रूरोऽसौ दुर्मतिः क्षुद्रो राज्यलुब्धोऽनपत्रपः॥
en: He is always in the evil look of Duryodhana. The Kurus are all wicked, narrow minded, covetous for sovereignty and impudent.

sa: रक्षसां तु शतं रामः शतेनैकेन कर्णिना। सहस्रं तु सहस्रेण जघान रणमूर्धनी॥
en: And in the field Rāma slew an hundred Rāks asa with an hundred Karnis, and a thousand (again) with a thousand.

sa: हति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा केशवः परवीरहा। तिर्यक्सरोषया दृष्ट्या वीक्षाचक्रे स मन्युमान्॥
en: Hearing these words of his, Keshava, that destroyer of hostile heroes, giving way to anger, cast an angry look at Kritavarman.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि पृरावृत्तं जनाधिप। वासुदेवस्य संवादं पृथिव्याश्चैव भारत॥
en: Bhishma said O Bharata, I shall, in this connection, recite to you the old story of Vasudeva and the goddess Earth.

sa: ते रुक्मपुङ्खा विशिखाः सधूमा इव पावकाः। निजध्नुस्तानि रक्षासिं वज्रा इव महाद्रुमान्॥
en: And as the thunderbolt slay the mighty, Asuras, those shafts studded with gold, and like to smoking fire, slew those Rākşasas.

sa: चिरं भुक्त्वा वसुमती प्रियां कान्तामिव प्रभुः॥ सर्वैरङ्गैः समानिश्लष्य प्रसुप्त इव चाभवत्।
en: Having enjoyed long the Earth like a dear wife, the powerful Shalya, now to sleep on the Earth's breast, embraced her.

sa: यावत्त्वं न वनं यातः पुरादस्मादतित्वरम्। पिता तावन्नते राम स्नास्यते भोक्ष्यतेऽपि वा॥
en: As long as you shall not hurriedly depart from his presence, Oh Rāma, your father shall not bathe, or eat anything.

sa: तपस्ते वर्धतां विप्र मत्प्रसादात् सहस्रधा। आश्रमे चेह वत्स्यामि त्वया सह महामुने॥
en: “O Brahmana, let your asceticism increase thousand-fold through my grace. O great Rishi, I shall live with you in your hermitage.

sa: मानना तु द्विजातीनां कर्तव्या वै महात्मनाम्॥ अवश्यं तपसा तेषां फलितव्यं नृपोत्तम।
en: It is proper, however, that the great Brahmanas should be honoured. Verily, O best of kings, their penances should bear fruits.

sa: तस्य मे कुरु साचिव्यं तस्य भार्यापहारणे। राक्षसेन्द्रवचः : श्रुत्वा मारीचो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Do you, therefore, assist me in carrying away his wife. Hearing these words of the lord of Rākş asas, Mārīca said.

sa: चरन्तं विविधान् मार्गान् मण्डलानि च सर्वशः। दुर्योधनमिमं शूरं कोऽन्यो हन्याद् वृकोदरात्॥
en: Who else, but you, O Vrikodara, could kill the heroic Duryodhana while moving about in various ways and performing various manoeuvres.

sa: पृथिव्यां पार्थिवाः सर्वे अभ्यागच्छन् दिदृक्षवः। तान् पूजयित्वा सम्प्राप्तान् यथार्ह स महीपतिः॥
en: All the kings of the world came to see him. The (Chedi) king worshipped the monarchs that came as each deserved.

sa: सहदेवस्तथेत्युक्त्वा तां दिशं प्रत्यपद्यत। ददर्श च हतं भूमौ भ्रातरं नकुलं तदा॥
en: Saying “be it so,” Sahadeva proceeded towards that direction and he then beheld his brother Nakula lying dead on the ground.

sa: तेषां ते क्षीरिणां क्षीरं पिबन्त्यमृतसंनिभम्॥ मिथुनं जायते काले समं तच्च प्रवर्धते।
en: They drink the milk of these “Milkyielding” trees which is as sweet as the ambrosia. The pair grow up there equally.

sa: स तेन बाणेन समर्पितेन जाम्बूनदाग्रेण सुसंहितेन। रराज राजन् महनीयकर्मा यथैकपर्वा रुचिरैकशृङ्गः॥३
en: And wounded with a sharp golden arrow on his forehead, that illustrious hero shone like a hill with a single peak.

sa: क्षणेन तस्य ते राजन् क्षयं जग्मुरजिह्मगाः। अक्षयाहि पुरा भूत्वा क्षीणा: क्षतजभोजनाः॥
en: Soon, however, O king, is arrows were exhausted. In former days his arrows had been inexhaustible. Now, however, they proved otherwise.

sa: पुत्र व्याधिर्न ते कच्चिच्छरीरं प्रति बाधते। अस्य राजकुलस्याद्य त्वदधीनं हि जीवितम्॥
en: My son, does any malady afflict your body? Now the life of this royal race is, without doubt, in your hands.

sa: शक्रप्रस्थमहं नेष्ये इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनं सुधर्मं यादवी सभाम्। प्रविवेशार्जुनः शूरः शोचमानो महारथान्॥
en: Having uttered these words, the heroic Arjuna, grieving for those great car-warriors, entered the great hall of the Yadavas, called Sudharma.

sa: अन्यदा मां पिता दृष्ट्वा कुपितोऽपि प्रसीदति। तस्य मामद्य सम्प्रेक्ष्य किमायासः प्रवर्तते॥
en: Angry though, he used to express joy whenever he saw me; then why does his sorrow prevail even seeing me to-day?

sa: किमिदं भाषसे राम वाक्यं लघुतया ध्रुवम्। त्वया यदपहास्यं मे श्रुत्वा नरवरोत्तम॥
en: It is that you speak me thus, thinking me, no doubt, mean minded. I can not but laugh at your words.

sa: येन येन शरीरेण यद्यत्कर्म करोत्ययम्। तेन तेन शरीरेण तत् तत् फलमुपाश्नुते॥
en: The good deeds with a person performs in a particular body yield rewards that the individual enjoys in that particular body.

sa: दृष्ट्वा तं पतितं भूमौ दूषणं निहतं रणे। साधु साध्विति काकुत्स्थं सर्वभूतान्यपूजयन्॥
en: Seeing Dūşaņa down on the ground, and slain in battle, all creatures, saying, ''well done! well done!" paid homage to Kākutstha.

sa: मत्कृते व्यसनं प्राप्तो लोकनाथो महाद्युतिः। सर्वान् कामान् परित्यज्य वने वसति राघवः॥
en: For me, having come by misfortune, and renounced every comfort, the effulgent lord of men, Rāghava, is dwelling in the woods.

sa: राजा वसुमना नाम कौसल्यो धीमतां वरः। महर्षि किल पप्रच्छ कृतप्रज्ञं बृहस्पतिम्॥
en: There was a highly intelligent king of Koshala, named Vasumanas. On a certain occasion he questioned the great wise sage Brihaspati.

sa: स राजा ब्रह्मदत्तस्तु पुरीमध्यवसत् तदा। काम्पिल्यां परया लक्ष्म्या देवराजो यथा दिवम्॥
en: And that king, Brahmadatta, founded the flourishing city of Kampilya, even as the sovereign of the celestials founded the celestial regions.

sa: तत्र देवा: सगन्धर्वा मासि मासि जनेश्वर॥ अभिगच्छन्ति तत् तीर्थं पुण्यं ब्राह्मणसेवितम्।
en: The celestials and the Gandharvas, every month, O king, go to that sacred shrine which is the resort of Brahman himself.

sa: अयं चापि विशुद्धात्मन् पुराणे श्रूयते विभो। मरुत्तेन महाबुद्धे गीतः श्लोको महात्मना॥
en: My lord of pure heart, even this Sloka is heard in the Puranas, sung by Maruta endued with a large soul.

sa: ये च त्वामनुजीवन्ति कच्चित् तेऽपि निरामयाः। सचिवा भृत्यवर्गाश्च गुरवश्चैव ते नृप॥
en: Are they who depend on you also happy? Are your ministers, and servitors, and all your seniors and preceptors also, happy?

sa: अर्थाद् वा यदि वा कामान्न किंचिदुपलक्षयेत्। पितृदेवातिथिकृते साधनं कुरुते च यः॥
en: He should never wish for anything from motives of gain or pleasure. He should adore the ancestors and gods and guests.

sa: स कृत्वा निनदं घोरं त्रासयंस्तां महाचमूम्। चकार हनूमान्वेगं तेषु रक्षःसु वीर्यवान्॥
en: Sending up a dreadful shout, and thereby filling that vast host with fright, the energetic Hanumān rushed on that Rākşasa army.

sa: न चैनमभ्यनन्दस्ते राजानो ब्राह्मणैः सह। सर्वे दुर्योधनं तत्र निन्दन्ति स्म सभासदः॥
en: Those kings along with the Brahmanas did not praise him for this; and all the courtiers there spoke ill of Duryodhana,

sa: उवाच धीमान् कौन्तेयः प्रहस्य सखिपूर्वकम्। कौरवाणां कुले जातः पाण्डोः पुत्रो विशेषतः॥
en: The son of Kunti said laughingly in a friendly way. “Born in the race of Kurus, especially being the son Pandu,

sa: बहुधा तस्य सैन्यस्य व्यूढस्याप्ततः शरैः। अधारयत वेगं स वेलेव तु महोदधेः॥
en: Like the bank (obstructing the surging) deep he withstood the various well-arranged divisions of the army falling upon him with arrows.

sa: त्वयोपगूढस्य च मे निद्रयापहृतं मनः। ततोऽपश्यं तमो घोरं पुरुषं च महौजसम्॥७११
en: Embraced by you, sleep gently came upon me. I then saw it was intensenly dark and also a highly effulgent person.

sa: संवत्सरः किंचिदूनो न निष्क्रान्ताहमाश्रमात्। वनं कुसुमितं द्रष्टुं परं कौतूहलं हि मे॥
en: I have not walked out for a little less than a year. Great indeed is my desire to witness the woods.

sa: वादित्राणि च सर्वाणि प्रत्युद्यान्तु सुतं मम॥ घण्टावान मानवः शीघ्रं मत्तमारुह्य वारणम्।
en: And all the musicians go out to receive iny son. Let the man who rings the bell, riding an infuriated elephant.

sa: वसूनां वा भवानेको रुद्राणामथवा भवान्। अथवा मरुतां श्रेष्ठो वलशी वा त्रिदशेश्वरः॥
en: Are you the best of the Marutas or the Rudras or the lord of the celestials, the wielder of the thunderbolt.

sa: प्रह्लाद उवाच इमौ तौ सम्प्रदृश्येते याभ्यां न चरितं सह। आशीविषाविव क्रुद्धावेकमार्गाविहागतौ॥
en: Prahrada said These two now appear, who have never before been together, like two enraged serpents coming by the same road.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तः स पार्थेन रथात् प्रस्कन्द्य कुण्डली। आरुरोह शमीवृक्षं वैराटिरवशस्तदा॥
en: Thus addressed by Partha, Virata's son, adorned with ear-rings, got down from the car and climbed up the Shami tree unwillingly.

sa: तत उत्थाय वैदेही तेषां मध्ये यशस्विनी। उवाच वाक्यं कल्याणी रामं पृथुलवक्षसम्॥
en: Then rising in the midst of them, the blessed and renowned princess of Videha spoke these words to the broad-chested Rama.

sa: अयं वत्से महाभागो ब्राह्मणो वस्तुमिच्छति। मम गेहे मया चास्य तथेत्येवं प्रतिश्रुतम्॥
en: "This highly fortunate Brahmana, O child, wishes to dwell in my house. I have promised hiin this saying “be it so."

sa: अर्जुन उवाच मा भैषीः स्तम्भयात्मानं त्वयापि नरपुङ्गवा अत्यद्भुतानि कर्माणि कृतानि रणमूर्धनि॥
en: Arjuna said Do not fear; cheer yourself up. You too, O foremost of men, performed many wonderful deeds in the battle-field.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच कृष्णस्य तु वचः श्रुत्वा धृतराष्ट्रो जनेश्वरः। विदुरं सर्वधर्मज्ञं त्वरमाणोऽभ्यभाषत॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing these words of Krishna Dhritarashtra, the lord of men, said in haste to Vidura conversant with all virtues.

sa: अनेन विजिता गावो जिताश्च कुरवो युधि। अन्य शङ्खप्रणादेन की मे बधिरीकृतौ॥
en: By him the kine have been rescued, the Kurus vanquished; and, by the sound of his conch, my ears were deafened.

sa: य आसीच्छरणं काले पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्। रणे तेन विराटेन भविता वः समागमः॥
en: He who has been the protector of the greatsouled Pandavas for a time, with that Virata will you meet in battle.

sa: चित्रयोधी च नकुलो महेष्वासो महाबलः। कच्चित् सकुशली कृष्ण वत्सो मम सुखैधितः॥
en: My son, that great bow-man, Nakula of great prowess, that veteran warrior, brought up in luxury, is he well, O Krishna?

sa: कामक्रोधौ हि पुरुषमर्थेभ्यो व्यपकर्षतः। तौ तु शत्रु विनिर्जित्य राजा विजयते महीम्॥
en: Desire and wrath snatch away a man from earthy good; after subjugating these two enemies does a king conquer the earth.

sa: राजसूयं पाण्डवस्य दृष्ट्वा क्रतुवरं महत्। मम स्पृहा समुत्पन्ना तां सम्पादय सूतज॥
en: O Suta's son, seeing the great sacrifice Rajasuya of the Pandavas, I desire to perform the same. Fulfill my this desire."

sa: रणे जित्वा कुरून् सर्वान् वज्रपाणिरिवासुरान्। यशो महदवाप्य त्वं प्रविशेदं पुरं पुनः॥
en: Defeating all the Kurus in battle like the holder of Vajra the Asuras and acquiring great fame, return to your city.

sa: घडेव तु गुणाः पुंसा न हातव्याः कदाचन। सत्यं दानमनालस्यमनसूया क्षमा धृतिः॥
en: The six qualities should never be renounced by a man viz, truth, charity, the reverse of laziness, benevolence, forgiveness and patience.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा वृत्रसंकाशं कुम्भकर्णं तरस्विनम्। गतासुं पतितं भूमौ राक्षसाः प्राद्रवन् भयात्॥
en: Seeing the mighty Kumbhakarna (powerful) as (the Asura) Vritra, lying dead on the ground, the Rakshasas ran away in (great) terror.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच ततो निर्याय स्वपुरात् कुम्भकर्णः सहानुगः। अपश्यत् कपिसैन्यं तज्जितकाश्यचतः स्थितम्॥
en: Markandeya said : Then having marched out of the city with his followers, Kumbhakarna beheld the victorious monkey-army lying before him.

sa: कृतानुयात्रा भूतैस्त्वं वरदा कामचारिणि। भारावतारे ये च त्वां संस्मरिष्यन्ति मानवाः॥ प्रणमन्ति च ये त्वां हि प्रभाते तु नरा भुवि। न तेषां दुर्लभं किंचित् पुत्रतो धनतोऽपि वा।॥ दुर्गात् तारयसे दुर्गे तत् त्वं दुर्गा स्मृता जनैः।
en: O giver of boon, capable of ranging every where at will, you are followed by celestials beings (in your journey). Persons who, for the purpose of shaking off their burdens, bow down to, or call upon, you in the morning on earth, attain all either in respect of children or riches. O Durga, as you rescue people from danger, you are called by them Durga.

sa: रथस्यासन् दश गजा गजस्य दश वाजिनः। नरा दश हयस्यासन् पादरक्षाः समन्ततः।।२२।
en: For every chariot there were ten elephants, for every elephants ten horses, for every horse ten men for the proper protection.

sa: गच्छन्तु दूतास्त्वरितं नगरं तव पार्थिव।॥ सुहृदां प्रियमाख्यातुं घोषयन्तु च ते जयम्।
en: O king, let emissaries speedily go to your city, to communicate this pleasant tidings to your friends and announce your victory.

sa: प्रतिजग्राह रामस्तं स्वागतेन महामनाः। सुग्रीवस्य तु शङ्काभूत् प्रणिधिः स्यादिति स्म ह॥
en: And the magnanimous Rama welcomed him with due honours. But Sugriva had his misgivings, considering that he might be a spy.

sa: तस्माद् दुःखार्जितस्यैव परित्यागः सुदुष्करः। न दुष्करतरं दानात् तस्माद् दानं मतं मम॥
en: As there is nothing harder to practise than charity, in my opinion, even bestowal of boons is superior to every thing.

sa: विशेषस्त्वत्र विज्ञेयो न्यायेनोपार्जितं धनम्। पात्रे काले च देशे च साधुभ्यः प्रतिपादयेत्॥
en: Specially this is to be remembered that wellgotten gains should in proper time and place be given away to pious men.

sa: सा रत्नभूता मनसः प्रियार्चिता सुता विराटस्य यथेन्द्रलक्ष्मीः। सुदर्शनीया प्रमुखे यशस्विनी प्रीत्याब्रवीदर्जुनमायतेक्षणा॥
en: That beautiful and illustrious daughter having large eyes, like a precious jem, or the prosperity of Indra, delightedly said to Arjuna.

sa: पनसो नाम मेधावी वानरः सुमहाबलः। कोटीर्दश द्वादश च त्रिंशत् पञ्च प्रकर्षति॥
en: The intelligent monkey, Panasa by name and endued with a vast strength collected together fifty two hundreds of millions (of monkeys).

sa: सर्वं एवं समर्था हि तव शत्रु प्रबाधितुम्। इन्द्रस्यापि भयं ह्येते जनयेयुर्महाहवे॥
en: All of them are competent to withstand your enemies and they will beget fear in even Indra in the great war,

sa: त्रयोदश हि वर्षाणि प्रतीक्षन्त्या गतानि मे। विधाय हृदये मन्युं प्रदीप्तमिव पावकम्॥
en: Thirteen years have elapsed, during which I was waiting, entertaining in my heart feelings of revenge which were like blazing fire.

sa: भीमसेन उवाच अहमेनं परित्रास्ये शासनात् तव पार्थिवा पश्य युध्यतः सह शत्रुभिः॥
en: Bhimasena said By your command, O king, I shall set him free: behold my great feat of fighting with the enemies.

sa: तस्मात् तेषु महादण्डः क्षेप्तव्यः क्षिप्रमच्युत। त्वया चैव महाबाहो पाण्डवैः सह संजयैः॥
en: Therefore should heavy punishment fall or them from yourself, O Acchyuta of long arms, supported by the Pandavas and the Srinjayas.

sa: युधिष्ठिरस्य दाशार्ह तच्चापि विदितं तव। यथोक्तः संजयश्चैव तच्च सर्वं श्रुतं त्वया॥
en: Yudhishthira, that too is known to you of the Dasharha race and by you has been heard all what Sanjaya said.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्रेण सामात्येन जनार्दन। यथा च संजयो राज्ञा मन्त्रं रहसि श्रावितः॥
en: By the son of Dhritarashtra within ministers, O Janardana; and what message was covered through Sanjaya in private by the king.

sa: धनुष्श्चैव निर्घोषः श्रुतपूर्वो न मे क्वचित्। अस्य शङ्खस्य शब्देन धनुषो निस्वनेन च॥ अमानुषाणां शब्देन भूतानां ध्वजवासिनाम्। रथस्य च निनादेन मनो मुह्यति मे भृशम्॥
en: Never have I heard before the twang of such a bow. With the blowing of this conch, the twang of this bow, the superhuman cries of creatures placed on the banner, and with the rattle of this chariot my mind has been greatly agitated.

sa: करेण च करं गृह्य कर्णस्य मुदितो भृशम्। कर्णोऽपि भ्रातृसहितमित्युवाच नृपं मुदा॥
en: Holding Karna by the hand he expressed his great delight. Karna also with great joy thus spoke to the king (Duryodhana).

sa: अद्रोहः सर्वभूतेषु कर्मणा मनसा गिरा। अनुग्रहश्च दानं च सतां धर्मः सनातनः॥
en: The eternal duty of the righteous is mercy and charity, benevolence and favour towards all creation in thought, word and deed.

sa: यतो नारोचयदयं विग्रहं तैर्महात्मभिः। किं तु संजय मे ब्रूहि पुनस्तेषां विचेष्टितम्॥
en: Since he does not desire fight with those ones of great soul; but, O Sanjaya, tell me again of their doings.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः कर्णः प्रहृष्टस्तु उपसंगम्य वासवम्। अमोघां शक्तिमभ्येत्य वव्रे सम्पूर्णमानसः॥
en: Vaishampayana said: Thereupon, Karna gladly approached Vasava. And desirous of obtaining an infallible dart, he, with his purposes (nearly) gratified spoke.

sa: युष्मासु ध्रियमाणेषु दुःखानि विविधान्युत। शोषयन्ति शरीरं मे किं नु दुःखमतः परम्॥
en: Alas, you being all alive these various woes (render my person emaciated) undermine my system; what can be sadder than this?

sa: मायाधिकास्त्वयुध्यन्त यदा शूरा वियद्गताः। तदा नो न समं युद्धमभवत् खेचरैः सह॥
en: When those heroes (the Gandharvas) fought with the illusion, then our battle with those rangers of skies became an unequal one.

sa: उत्तराभ्यां फल्गुनीभ्यां नक्षत्राभ्यामहं दिवा। जातो हिमवतः पृष्ठे तेन मां फाल्गुनं विदुः॥
en: I was born on the Himavat when the constellation Uttara Phalguna was on the ascendant and hence they call me Phalguni.

sa: निरुष्य हि वने वासं कृत्वा कर्मातिमानुषम्। अभिवादयते पार्थः श्रोत्रे च परिपृच्छति॥
en: Passing by others they touch my ears. Having completed the term of his exile in the forest and performed superhuman deeds,

sa: एतच्च कर्णो यत् प्राह सर्वमीहामहे तथा। यथोद्दिष्टं चराः सर्वे मृगयन्तु यतस्ततः॥
en: This and what Karna has said have my full approbation. As directed let all those spies search at all those places.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तच्छ्रुत्वा द्रौपदी भीममुवाच व्याकुलेन्द्रिया। कुपिता ह्रीमती प्राज्ञा पती भीमार्जुनावुभौ॥
en: Vaishampayana said: Hearing those words Draupadi was excited; that bashful, angry and intelligent (lady) said to her husbands Bhima and Arjuna.

sa: भयानकानि विषये व्यालादीनि न सन्ति मे। मन्त्रगुप्तानि भूतानि न हिंसन्ति भयंकराः॥
en: In my territories there are no terrible snakes and frightful beasts do not injure men who are protected by my incantations.

sa: राजपुत्र निवर्तस्व न ते युक्तं पलायनम्। कथं ह्यनुचरान् हित्वा शत्रुमध्ये पलायसे॥
en: Desist, O princes it does not behoove you, leaving your followers in the midst of enemies, to take to your heels?

sa: मत्स्नेहाच्चैव राधायां सद्यः क्षीरमवातरत्। सा मे मूत्रं पुरीषं च प्रतिजग्राह माधव॥
en: Out of affection for me, Radha too got milk in her bosom and she held my urine and excrete, O Madhava.

sa: पुष्पोत्कटा च राका च मालिनी च विशाम्पते। अन्योन्यस्पर्धया राजन् श्रेयस्कामाः सुमध्यमाः॥
en: O lord of the world, O king, Pushpotkata and Raka and Malini, slender waisted, vied with one another in pleasing him.

sa: तमुवाच ततो ज्येष्ठो भ्राता सप्रणयं वचः। मुञ्चैनमधमाचारं प्रमाणा यदि ते वयम्॥
en: Thereupon his eldest brother said to him a affectionate terms. "If you have any regard for me let him be free."

sa: कालस्य च हि मृत्योश्च जङ्गमस्थावरस्य च। ईशते भगवानेकः सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: That prosperous Being alone is lord over Time, Death and over all mobile and immobile beings. I tell you the truth.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच समवेतेषु सर्वेषु तेषु राजसु भारत। दुर्योधनमिदं वाक्यं भीष्मः शान्तनवोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said In the midst of all those kings, O Bharata, Bhima, the son of Shantanu, spoke these words of Duryodhana:

sa: विदुर उवाच तौ विवादमनुप्राप्तौ शकुनौ मृत्युसंधितौ। विगृह्य च सुदुर्बुद्धी पृथिव्यां संनिपेततुः॥
en: Vidura said The two birds who were doomed to death quarreled; and having quarrelled the two fools fell to the earth.

sa: चरा ऊचुः कृतोऽस्माभिः परो यत्नस्तेषामन्वेषणे सदा। पाण्डवानां मनुष्येन्द्र तस्मिन् महति कानने॥
en: The spies said O king of men, we have with great care searched the sons of Pandu in that huge forest.

sa: अचक्षुर्लभते चक्षुर्वृद्धो भवति वै युवा। इति ते कथयन्ति स्म ब्राह्मणा जम्भसाधकाः॥
en: Those without eyes get eyes, and the old become young. There was the honey described by the Brahmanas conversant with incantations.

sa: तं तु दृष्ट्वा शरं घोरं देवगन्धर्वमानवाः। स्वस्त्यस्तु समरे राजन् द्रोणायेत्यब्रुवन् वचः॥
en: Beholding that dreadful shaft, o king, the Gods, the Danavas and the Gandharvas said these words viz., “May good betide Drona."

sa: इदानीमेव द्रष्टासि प्रधाने स्यन्दने स्थितौ। पुत्रं च वसुदेवस्य कुन्तीपुत्रं च पाण्डवम्॥
en: You will soon see stationed on that best of cars the son of Vasudeva and the son of Kunti and Pandu.

sa: कौरवेय न मे त्रासः कथंचिदपि विद्यते। त्वया सार्धमथान्यैश्च युध्यतो हृदि कश्चन॥
en: "O descendant of the Kurus, I entertain not the least fear in my heart whether fighting with you or with others.

sa: थे च तेऽभ्यद्रवन् द्रोणं व्यूढानीकः प्रहारिणः। सुंजयाः सह पञ्चास्तेऽप्यकुर्वन् कथं रणम्॥
en: How did the Panchalas and the Srinjayas, arranged in order and well-skilled in smiting, fight, having rushed upon Drona in battle.

sa: निपतन्ति तथैवान्ये स्फुरन्ति च सहस्रशः। वेगांश्चान्ये रणे चक्रुः पञ्चास्या इव पन्नगाः॥
en: Thousands of such arms fell down on the earth and sprang up and many seemed to dart forward like five-headed snakes.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा सुसंक्रुद्धः सोमदत्तो महाबलः दध्मौ शङ्ख च तारेण सिंहनादं ननाद च॥
en: The highly powerful Somadatta, excited with wrath, having said thus, blew loudly (his) conch and sent forth roars like a lion.

sa: यस्य वीर्येण वीर्यं ते धार्तराष्ट्रोऽवमन्यते। तमद्य पार्थ संग्रामे कर्ण वैकर्तनं जहि॥
en: Do in today's battle kill that Vaikartana Karna, counting upon whose prowess the sons of Dhritarashtra over look your manly virtues.

sa: न च वैतादृशो व्यूह आसीत् कश्चिद् विशाम्पते। यादृग् जयद्रथवधे द्रोणेन विहितोऽभवत्॥
en: Horripilating, dreadful and deafening was the uproar set up by those enraged heroes of resolute deeds, as they proceeded to battle.

sa: काम्बोज निहतं दृष्ट्वा तथालम्बुषमेव च। अन्यान् बहूंश्च सुहृदो जीवितार्थोऽद्य को मम॥
en: Beholding the king of Kamboja, Alambusha and many other friends lose their lives, what is the good of preserving my life?

sa: संजय उवाच ततः कर्णो महेष्वासः पाण्डवानामानीकिनीम्। जघान समरे शूरः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: Sanjaya said Then the mighty bowman, the heroic Karna, killed the troops of the Pandavas in battle with the straight arrows.

sa: दुपदस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो वृषसेनस्य कार्मुकम्। द्विधा चिच्छेद भल्लेन पीतेन निशितेन च॥
en: Thereupon, Drupada, excited with wrath, cut-off the bow of Vrishasena into fragments by means of a sharpened and well-tempered broad-headed arrow.

sa: बलाहकौघश्च दिशस्तरस्वी चकार सर्वास्तिमिरेण संवृताः। ततो धरित्रीधरतुल्यरोधसः समन्ततो वै परिवार्य वारिणा॥
en: Huge masses of clouds instantly covered the sides with darkness; they resembled big mountains and poured heavy showers upon the earth.

sa: स रथः प्रद्रुतः संख्ये मण्डलानि सहस्रशः। चकार राजतो राजन् भ्राजमान इवांशुमान्॥
en: That resplendent chariot, Oking, dragged over all parts of the field, began to describe various circles like the Sun in motion.

sa: एते दीर्यन्ति सगणाः पञ्चालानां महारथाः॥ दृष्ट्वा केसरिणं क्रुद्धं मृगा इव महावने।
en: As in a forest a wrathful lion scares away herd of deers so the mighty Panchala warriors are melting (before Karna).

sa: योऽजयत् पृथिवीं सर्वा रथेनैकेन वीर्यवान्। तं सूततनयं युद्धे कथं भीमो ह्ययोधयत्॥
en: How did Bhima fight with that highly puissant son of Suta, who on a single car had vanquished the three worlds?

sa: सोऽहं तत्र गमिष्यामि यत्र ते पुरुषर्षभाः। हता मदर्थे संग्रामे युध्यमानाः किरीटिना॥
en: I will go there whither those foremost of men, slain for may sake in battle by the fighting Kiriti, have departed.

sa: श्रान्तं चैनं समालक्ष्य ज्ञात्वा दूरे च सैन्धवम्। सिंहनादेन महता सर्वतः पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Beholding them fatigued and knowing the ruler of the Sindhus to be stationed afar, they surrounded Arjuna with a loud roar.

sa: सोऽभ्ययात्त्वरितः कर्ण विसृजन् सायकान् बहून्॥ तस्य कर्ण: शितान् बाणान् प्रतिहत्य हसन्निव।
en: And he in his turn assailed Karna, quickly shooting numerous arrows. Thereupon Karna smilingly destroyed all those sharp arrows of Bhima.

sa: ततो घटोत्कचः क्रुद्धो रक्षसां भीमकर्मणाम्। द्रौणिं हतेति महती चोदयामास तां चमूम्॥
en: Then Ghatotkacha, greatly enraged ordered that vast army of Rakshasas capable of achieving terrible feats, to slay the son of Drona.

sa: स तस्य देहावरणं भित्त्वा देहं च सायकः॥ सपुङ्खपत्रः पृथिवीं विवेश रुधिरोक्षितः।
en: That furnished with beautiful feathery wings, penetrating through the armour and body of Satyaki, entered the earth, being steeped in blood.

sa: एतचक्रं गदा शङ्खः शार्ङ्ग कृष्णसह्यच च प्रभो। दृश्यते पाण्डवरथे वाहयान्सय वाजिनः॥
en: Lord Sri Krishna's discus, gada, conch and sarnga bow are being seen here. He is driving the horses of Panduputra, Arjuna.

sa: यथा ह्यभ्युदितः सूर्यः प्रतपन् स्वेन तेजसा। व्यपोहति समस्तीव्र तथा शत्रून् प्रतापय॥
en: So, do you exterminate all the enemies, even as the risen Sun, burning by his own energy, destroys the awful darkness.

sa: अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि संवार्य तेषां कर्णस्य वा विभो। अविद्ध्यत् सात्यकिः क्रुद्धो वृषसेनं स्तनान्तरे॥
en: Placing Karna in front of them, your sons then, O ruler of men, began to pierce Satyaki simultaneously with sharp arrows.

sa: द्वितीयामिव सम्प्राप्ताममन्यन्त निशां तदा। न ज्ञायन्ते कौरवेया न पञ्चाला न पाण्डवाः॥
en: Every body thought that night had once more set in. Neither the Kouravas, nor the Panchalas, the Pandavas could be distinguished.

sa: शक्तोऽपि नावधीत् कर्ण समर्थः पाण्डुनन्दनः। रक्षमाणः प्रतिज्ञां तां या कृता सव्यसाचिना॥
en: Thus the son of Pandu, though competent, did not slay Karna, desirous of keeping inviolate the vow that Arjuna had made.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्येवं धृतराष्ट्रोऽथ विलप्य बहु दुःखितः। प्रोवाच संजय भूयः शोकव्याकुलमानसः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Dhritarashtra wailed so deep, became impatient in vagary of agony and grief and again said Sanjaya the following words-

sa: स त्वमातिष्ठ यानाय यत्र यातो धनंजयः। ममापि रक्षणं भीमः करिष्यति महाबलः॥
en: Therefore prepare yourself for proceeding to the spot where Dhananjaya has gone. The highly powerful Bhima will look after my protection.

sa: स भित्त्वा हृदयं तस्य राक्षसस्य महाशरः॥ विवेश वसुधां शीघ्रं सुपुङ्खः पृथिवीपते।
en: O Lord of earth, that great arrow furnished with beautiful wings, riving the heart of that Rakshasa, penetrated into the earth.

sa: संजय उवाच शतानीकं शरैस्तूर्णं निर्दहन्तं चमू तवा चित्रसेनस्तव सुतो वारयामास भारत॥
en: Sanjaya said O Bharata, your son Chitrasena withstood Satnika, the of Nakula, who consuming your troops with keen arrows. son was

sa: यथा चक्रं तु कौलालो दण्डविद्ध तु भारत। सहैव भूरिश्रवसो बाहुना केशधारिणा॥
en: Together with the arm of Bhurisravas that held it by the hair, like a potters wheel whirling round with the rod.

sa: हन्त शल्य विजानीहि हन्त भूयो ब्रवीमि ते॥ यदन्योऽप्युक्तवान् मह्यं ब्राह्मणः कुरुसंसदि।
en: You should always know this, O Shalya. I will now speak to you what another Brahmana said in the Kuru court.

sa: सहदेवे ततः षष्टिं सायकान् दुर्मुखोऽक्षिपत्। ननाद च महानादं तर्जयन् पाण्डवं रणे॥
en: Durmukha then hurled sixty shafts at Sahadeva and he uttered a loud war-cry defying in that battle that son of Pandu.

sa: रथेभ्यस्त्ववतीर्णाः स्म सर्व एव हि तावकाः। तस्मात् त्वमपि कौन्तेय रथात् तूर्णमपाक्रम॥
en: All your troops have alighted from their chariots, so you also, O son of Kunti, quickly come down from your chariot.

sa: ते वध्यमाना भीमेन गजा राजन् विदुद्रुवुः॥ केचिद् विभिन्नहृदयाः कुञ्जरा न्यपतन् भुवि।
en: Assailed by Bhima, O king, the elephants fled away on all sides. Some, cut to their hearts, fell down on earth.

sa: तथैव चेदिमत्स्येषु पञ्चालेषु तथैव च। हतेषु त्रिषु वीरेषु दुपदस्य च नृप्पृषु॥
en: As also the Chedis and the Panchalas and the Matsyas and upon the slaughter of the three heroic grandsons of Drupada.

sa: सात्यकिः शकुनि विद्ध्वा विंशत्या निशितैः शरैः। ध्वजं चिच्छेद भल्लेन सौबलस्य हसन्निव॥
en: Having pierced Shakuni with twenty sharp arrows Satyaki, as if smiling, struck down the standard of Subala's son with his dart.

sa: स तु विद्राव्य समरे पाण्डवन् संजयानपि॥ एक एव रणे भीष्म एकवीरत्वमागतः।
en: Indeed he had achieved an unrivalled heroism in the field, having routed the Pandavas and the Srinjayas all single-handed in battle.

sa: स सृञ्जयानां सर्वेषां पञ्चालानां च मारिष। केकयानां विदेहानां चकार कदनं महत्॥
en: He caused a great slaughter among the Srinjayas, all the Panchalas, the Kekayas and the Videhas, in the sight of all.

sa: अवारोहद् रथात् तस्मादथ कर्णो महारथः। गदां गृहीत्वा समरे भीमाय प्राहिणोद् रुषा॥
en: Thereupon the mighty car-warrior Karna descended from his chariot and taking up a mace hurled it at Bhimasena with great fury.

sa: सैन्येन रजसा मूढां सर्वमनधमिवाभवत्। नैव ते न वयं राजन् प्राज्ञासिष्म परस्परम्॥
en: one a Confounded with the dust thc troops became blind. Neither the foe, O monarch, nor we could distinguish one another.

sa: भीमसेन उवाच अपयात इतो राजा धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। कर्मबाणाभितप्ताङ्गो यदि जीवेत् कथञ्चन्॥
en: Bhima said Wounded with Karna's arrows the pious king Yudhishthira had gone away from here. I doubt if he still survives.

sa: इच्छन्ति पितरः पुत्रान् स्वार्थ हेतोर्घटोत्कच। इहलोकात् परे लोके तारयिष्यन्ति ये हिताः॥
en: O Ghatotkacha, fathers desire to have sons, for furthering their own interests. And goc sons save their fathers here and hereafter.

sa: दृष्ट्वा तु पार्थे संरब्धं वासुदेवं च मारिष। प्रसन्नेव पुत्रस्ते योद्धुकामः समाह्वयत्॥
en: Beholding Partha and Vasudeva both filled with wrath, your son desirous of fighting with them, smiling, challenged them to the combat.

sa: राज्ञो रथमभिप्रेक्ष्य विद्रुताः शतशोऽभरन्। विद्रुतं तत्र तत् सैन्यं दृष्ट्वा भारत सात्यकिः॥
en: Looking at the chariot of the king, began to break away by hundreds. Then O Bharata, beholding the divisions routed, Satyaki.

sa: युयुधानस्तु तं राजन् प्रत्युवाच हसन्निव। कौरवेय न संत्रासो विद्यमे मम संयुगे॥
en: Thereupon, O king, Yuyudhana smilingly replied to him saying,"O illustrious descendant of the Kuru race, I have no fear in fight.

sa: तस्य प्रमुखतो राजन् येऽवर्तन्त महारथाः। तान् सर्वान् प्रेषयामास पितृलोकं स भारत॥
en: And Drona sent all those mighty carwarriors, those lords of earth who confronted hiin to the region of Pitris, O king.

sa: स हि भीमेन बलिना जातः सुरपराक्रमः। तस्मिन्नस्राणि दिव्यानि राक्षसान्यासुराणि च॥ सततं चानुरक्तो वो हितैषी च घटोत्कचः। विजेष्यति रणे कर्णमिति मे नात्र संशयः॥
en: Therefore let the mighty Ghatotkacha charge the son of Radha. That one of prowess resembling that of an immortal, was begotten by Bhima and he is conversant with numerous celestial, Asuri and Rakshasa-weapons. I am sure, he will conquer Karna in battle.

sa: तथा सुवर्णशृङ्गीणां गोधेनूनां चतुःशतम्॥ दद्यां तस्मै सवत्सानां यो मे ब्रूयाद् धनंजयम्।
en: I shall also give the person who will point out Arjuna four hundred kine, each with golden horns and her calf.

sa: यत्र यत्र रथो याति पाण्डवस्य महात्मनः। तत्र तत्रैव दीर्यन्ते सेनास्तव विशाम्पते॥
en: Wherever the car of the illustrious son of Pandu proceeded, thither O ruler of men your troops began to give way.

sa: अश्वत्थामंस्त्वरायुक्तो याहि शीघ्रमरिंदमा आदौ वा यदि वा पश्चात् तवेदं कर्म मारिष॥
en: Ashvatthama, O chastiser of foes march (against them) speedily. Earlier or latter this take should be accomplished by you, O Brahmana.

sa: संजय उवाच प्रागेव विद्रुतान् दृष्ट्वा धार्तराष्ट्रान् युधिष्ठिरः। पुनश्च तुमुलं शब्दं श्रुत्वार्जुनमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Sanjaya said At first having seen the Dhartarashtras routed and again beholding them return to the attack Yudhishthira addressing Arjuna said

sa: शिरांस्येतानि पात्यन्ते शत्रूणां बाहवोऽपि च॥ रथनागहया वीरा यशस्याः सर्व एव च।
en: They are striking down the heads and arms of their enemies. Their car-warriors, elephantwarriors and cavalry are all heroic and praiseworthy.

sa: संजय उवाच दुर्योधनस्य शकुनेर्मम दुःशासनस्य च। रात्रौ रात्रौ भवत्येषा नित्यमेव समर्थना॥
en: Sanjaya said Indeed, every night, O monarch, this used to form the subject of deliberation among Duryodhana, Sakuni, Dushasana and myself.

sa: ततस्ते व्याकुलीभूताः राजानः कर्णपीडिताः॥ बभ्रमुस्तत्र तत्रैव गावः शीतार्दिता इव। हयानां वध्यमानानां गजानां रथिनां तथा॥ तत्र तत्राभ्यवेक्षाम संघान् कर्णेन ताडितान्। शिरोभिः पतितै राजन् बाहुभिश्च समन्ततः॥ आस्तीर्णा वसुधा सर्वा शूराणामनिवर्तिनाम्। हतैश्च हन्यमानैश्च निष्टनदिश्च सर्वशः॥
en: Wandered about there on the field of battle) like cows pained with cold. Innumerable horses, elephants and car-warriors afflicted by Karna were seen to drop dead there. The entire field was strewn on all sides with the fallen heads and arms of the unretreating warriors, O king, with the dead and the dying and the waiting (combatants) lying on all sides.

sa: संजय उवाच द्रौणिस्तु रथवंशेन महता परिवारितः। अपतत्सहसा राजन् यत्र पार्थो व्यवस्थितः॥
en: Sanjaya said Thereupon surrounded be a mighty carforce Drona's son appeared, all on a sudden O king, where Pritha's son was.

sa: अनर्जुना न शक्ष्यन्ति महीं भोक्तुं कथञ्चन॥ तेषु नष्टेषु सर्वेषु पृथिवीयं ससागरा।
en: Will not able to enjoy the earth without Arjuna. At the destruction of all these, this, earth together with her seas.

sa: अनिकेतोऽथ राजा स बभूव वनगोचरः। ते चापि सहिते देव्यौ संजयश्च तमन्वयुः॥
en: The king had no fixed dwelling. He became a wanderer through those forests. The two queens, as also Sanjaya, followed him.

sa: स राजन् धर्मशीलेन राज्ञा बीभत्सुना तथा। अनुनीतो महाबाहुः सौहृदे स्थापितोऽपि च॥
en: That mighty-armed hero, O monarch, was solicited by the righteous king as also by Bibhatsu, and induced to treat you cordially.

sa: यश्च पौरजनः कश्चिद् द्रष्टुमिच्छति पार्थिवम्। अनावृतः सुविहितः स च यातु सुरक्षितः॥
en: Whoever amongst the citizens wishes to see the king, is allowed to do so without any restriction. Let him properly protected.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तच्छ्रुत्वा कुरुराजस्य वाक्यानि करुणानि ते। सर्वशो राजन् समेताः कुरुजाङ्गलाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing these pitiable words of the Kuru king, O monarch, the assembled dwellers of Kurujangala all began to weep.

sa: प्रतिगृह्य तु तद् रत्नं कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनिः॥ ऋत्विग्भ्यः प्रददौ विद्वांश्चतुर्धा व्यभजंश्च ते।
en: Accepting that wealth, the Island-born sage, Krishna, of great learning, gave it to the sacrificial priests, dividing it into four parts.

sa: सौति उवाच एतच्छुत्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठात् स राजा जनमेजयः। पूजयामास तमृषिमनुमान्य पुनः पुनः॥
en: Sauti said--Having heard this from that foremost of twice-born ones, king Janamejaya adored that Rishi, repeatedly honouring him in every way.

sa: माधवस्यास्य माहात्म्यं श्रुतं यत् कथितं मया। तदेव तावत् पर्याप्तं सज्जनस्य निदर्शनम्॥
en: You have heard me sing the glory and greatness of Madhava. That is sufficient for making a good man understand Him.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच श्रुत्वेतिहासं भीष्मोक्तं गङ्गायाः स्तवसंयुतम्। युधिष्ठिरः परां प्रीतिमगच्छद् भ्रातृभिः सह॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing this discourse from Bhishma of the praise of Ganga, Yudhishthira with his brothers became filled with great joy.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच प्राप्य राज्यं महात्मानः पाण्डवा हतशत्रवः। धृतराष्ट्र पुरस्कृत्य पृथिवीं पर्यपालयन्॥
en: Vaishampayana said, Having regained their kingdom, the great Pandavas, their enemies all killed, ruled the earth, placing Dhritarashtra at their head.

sa: एते चान्ये च बहवो बहुत्वाद् ये न कीर्तिताः। सर्वे भासुरदेहास्ते समुत्तस्थुर्जलात्ततः॥
en: These and innumerable others appeared on that occasion. All of the rose from the waters of the Bhagirathi with shining bodies.

sa: लोकान् बहुविधान् दिव्यान् यच्चास्य हृदि वर्तते। तत् सर्वं समवाप्नोति कर्मणैतेन मानवः॥
en: For such an act a man acquires many a region of happiness, in fact, whatever happiness he seeks in his heart.

sa: बह्वीस्तु संसरन् योनीर्जायमानः पुनः पुनः। पर्याये तात कस्मिंश्चिद् ब्राह्मणो नाम जायते॥
en: Passing through numberless orders of existence by undergoing repeated births, one at last in some birth, becomes born as a Brahmana.

sa: शब्दस्पर्शी च विज्ञेयौ द्विगुणो वायुरुच्यते॥ वायोश्चापि गुणः स्पर्शः स्पर्शश्च बहुधा स्मृतः।
en: Sound and touch should be known as the two qualities of wind. Touch has been said to be of various sorts.

sa: ततः स बाल्यात् पितरं विव्याध हृदि पत्रिणा। निशितेन सुपुढेन बलवद् बभ्रुवाहनः॥
en: From a spirit of childishness he then vigorously cut his father in the breast with a whetted arrow having excellent wings.

sa: यदि तेऽहमनुग्राह्यो भ्रातृभिः सहितोऽनघ। वक्तुमर्हसि नः प्रश्नं यत् त्वां पृच्छामि पार्थिव॥
en: If, O sinless one, I with my brothers deserve your labour, you should answer the questions I wish to ask you.

sa: धिक् तस्य जीवितं राज्ञो राष्ट्रे यस्यावसीदति। द्विजोऽन्योवा मनुष्योऽपि शिबिराह वचो यथा॥
en: King Shivi himself had said this, viz.-Fie on that king in whose kingdom a Brahmana or even any other man starves.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच एवं प्रयाचति तदा भास्करे मुनिसत्तमः। जगदग्निर्महातेजाः किं कार्यं प्रत्यपद्यत॥
en: Yudhishthira said What did that foremost of ascetics, viz., Jamadagni gifted with great energy, do when thus besought by the Sun?

sa: अन्यान्याश्चैव तनवो यथेष्टं प्रतिपद्यते। विनिवृत्य जरां मृत्युं न शोचति न हृष्यति॥
en: He succeeds in assuming various bodies according as as he wishes. Turning away decrepitude and death, he neither grieves nor exalis.

sa: ततः स पूजितो नागैस्तदोत्तङ्कः प्रतापवान्। अग्निं प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा जगाम गुरुसा तत्॥
en: Thus honoured by them, Utanka of great prowess, going round the god of fire, started for the hermitage of his preceptor,

sa: इत्युक्तवाक्ये धर्मे तु यानमारुह्य स द्विजः॥ सदारः ससुतश्चैव सस्नुषश्च दिवं गतः।
en: After the deity of Righteousness had said these words, that Brahmana, with his wife, son, daughter-in-law, proceeded to the celestial region.

sa: तथा मांस च मेदश्च स्नाय्वस्थीनि च योषिति। कथमेतानि सर्वाणि शरीराणि शरीरिणाम्॥
en: How docs it nourish the flesh, the marrow, the sinews, the bones? How do all these limbs of embodied creatures grow?

sa: निदाघकाले पानीयं तडागे यस्य तिष्ठति। वाजिमेधफलं तस्य फलं वै मुनयो विदुः॥
en: That man in whose tank water lies in the season of summer, wins, the Rishi say, the merits of a horsesacrifice.

sa: अहं विचित्रवीर्यस्य द्वे कन्ये समुदावहम्। जित्वा च मागधान्सर्वान् काशीनाथं च कोसलान्।।३८
en: was Formerly, having defeated all the Magadhas, the Kashis, and the Koshalas, I bought away by force two maidens for Vichitravirya.

sa: इत्युक्तः प्रीतिमान् विप्रः कृष्णेन स बभूव ह। अद्याप्युत्तङ्कमेघाच मरौ वर्षन्ति भारत॥
en: Thus addressed by Krishna, Utanka became Glad, and to this day, O Bharata, Utankaclouds (appear and) shower rain on arid deserts.

sa: ते दीनमनसः सर्वे देवता ऋषयश्च ये। प्रजग्मुः शरणं देवं ब्रह्माणमजरं विभुम्॥
en: Then the celestials and the Rishis, with depressed hearts, sought the protection of the illustrious and powerful Brahman of unfading glory.

sa: यच्चापि सर्वं वस्तु तच्चैव प्रतिपादितम्। परं न लेखकः कश्चिदेतस्य भुवि विद्यते॥
en: All these have been placed is this poem, but a writer for this work is not to be found on earth.

sa: आस्तीक उवाच न संतापस्त्वया कार्यः कथंचित्पन्नगोत्तम। प्रदीप्ताग्नेः समुत्पन्नं नाशयिष्यामि ते भयम्॥
en: Astika said: O best of snakes, you should not grieve any longer. I shall dispel your fear of the blazing fire.

sa: सा बलिं त्वरिता देवी धर्मायोपजहार ह। जजाप विधिवज्जष्यं दत्तं दुर्वाससा पुरा॥
en: That lady (Kunti) offered adorations to Dharma and repeated in the proper form the Mantra, formerly given to her by Durvasa.

sa: सौहृदं मे त्वया ह्यासीत् पूर्वं सामर्थ्यबन्धनम्। नाश्रोत्रियः श्रोत्रियस्य नारथी रथिनः सखा॥
en: We had friendship between us when we were both equally circumstance, but Time that wears out everything, wears out friendship also.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तच्छ्रुत्वा कौरवेयास्ते तूष्णीमासन् विशाम्पते। अर्जुनस्तु ततः सर्वं प्रतिजज्ञे परंतप॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Hearing these words, the Kuru princes remained silent. O chastiser of foes, Arjuna, (however), vowed to accomplish it.

sa: ततोऽर्जुनं तदा मूर्ध्नि समाघ्राय पुनः पुनः। प्रीतिपूर्वं परिष्वज्य प्ररुरोद मुदा तदा॥
en: Drona then cheerfully clasped Arjuna to his bosom and repeatedly took the scent of his head and shed tears of joy.

sa: इन्द्र उवाच लोके धर्म पालय त्वं नित्ययुक्तः समाहितः। धर्मयुक्तस्ततो लोकान्पुण्यान्पश्यसि शाश्वतान्॥
en: Indra said: Protect attentively and rigidly piety on earth. Protecting virtue on earth, you will see many sacred regions (in after-life).

sa: पाण्डवाश्च सहद्रोणाः सकृपाश्च विशाम्पते। भीष्मेण सहिताः सर्वे ययुः स्वं स्वं निवेशनम्॥
en: The Pandavas also with Drona, Kripa and Bhishma returned to their own homes. All the people also went the respective houses.

sa: तस्य पार्थो धनुश्छित्त्वा ध्वज चोळमपातयत्। पञ्चभिस्तस्य विव्याध हयान् सूतं च सायकैः॥
en: Cutting off his bow and felling his flatstaff on the grounds he pierced his enemy's horses and charioteer with five arrows.

sa: यदि भागशतं पेशी कृता तेन महर्षिणा। न प्रजास्यति चेद् भूयः सौबलेयी कथंचन॥ कथं तु सम्भवस्तस्या दुःशलाया वदस्व मे। यथावदिह विप्रः परं मेऽत्र कुतूलहम्॥
en: The ball of flesh was divided by the great Rishi into only one hundred parts and the daughter of Subala (Gandhari) did not conceive at any other time. How then was born Duhshala? O Brahmana Rishi, tell me this; my curiosity is very great.

sa: क्रोधो हि धर्मं हरति यतीनां दुःखसंचितम्। ततो धर्मविहीनानां गतिरिष्टां न विद्यते॥
en: Anger diminishes the merits that ascetics acquire with great pains. There is no hope for those who are deprived of virtue.

sa: अन्तरिक्षचरी ह्यस्मि कामतो विचरामि च। अतुलामाप्नुहि प्रीतिं तत्र तत्र मया सह॥
en: I can travel in the sky and I do so at pleasure. You may enjoy with incomparable pleasure in those place."

sa: एतेषां प्रसवो यश्च प्रसवस्य च संततिः। असंख्येयेति मत्वा तान्न ब्रवीमि तपोधन॥
en: O Rishi, the sons and the grandsons of the snakes were innumerable, therefore, I shall not mention their names to you.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः शान्तनवो भीष्मो राज्ञः पाण्डोर्यशस्विनः। विवाहस्यापरस्यार्थे चकार मतिमान् मतिम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Some time after, the son of Shantanu, the intelligent Bhishma, thought of marrying Pandu to a second wife.

sa: राक्षसाय च तत् सर्वं प्रापयिष्यति भोजनम्। मोक्षयिष्यति चात्मानमिति मे निश्चिता मतिः॥
en: He will reach the food of the Rakshasa, but he will be able to save himself; this is my firm belief.

sa: ततः स पुनरुद्यम्य वृक्षान् बहुविधान् बली। प्राहिणोद् भीमसेनाय तस्मै भीमश्च पाण्डवः॥
en: Then that mighty Rakshasas tearing up various trees, hurled them at Bhima and that Pandava also (hurled) many on the Rakshasas.

sa: सौतिरुवाच ततो रजन्या व्युष्टायां प्रभातेऽभ्युदिते रवौ। कदूश्च विनताचैव भगिन्यौ तै तपोधन॥
en: Sauti said: O Rishi, when the night was gone and the sun rose in the morning, the sisters, Kadru and Vinata.

sa: जन्मप्रभृति यत् किंचिद् दृष्टवान् स महीपतिः। रूपं न सदृशं तस्यास्तर्कयामास किंचन॥
en: Nothing that the king has seen from the day of his birth could equal, he argued, the beauty of that girl.

sa: सौतिरुवाच कालेन महता कद्दूरण्डानां दशतीर्दश। जनयामास विप्रेन्द्र द्वे चाण्डे विनता तदा॥
en: Sauti said: O best of Brahmanas, after a long time Kadru gave birth to one thousand eggs and Vinata two eggs.

sa: मनोहरायाः शिशिरः प्राणोऽथ रमणस्तथा। अह्नः सुतस्तथा ज्योतिः : शमः शान्तस्तथा मुनिः।।२३।
en: The fascinating Varchasvi had three sons, namely Shishira, Prana and Ramana. The sons of Aha were Jyoti, Shama, Shanta and Muni.

sa: स तु शप्तस्तदा तेन शक्तिना वै नृपोत्तमः। जगाम शरणं शक्तिं प्रसादयितुमर्हयन्॥
en: Then that best of kings, (Kalmashapada), having been thus cursed by Shakti, asked the protection of Shakti by humbly beseeching him.

sa: तस्य भावं विदित्वा स नृपतेः कुरुसत्तम। विश्वामित्रस्ततो रक्ष आदिदेश नृपं प्रति॥
en: O best of the Kuru race, knowing the disposition of the king, Vishvamitra ordered a Rakshasas to enter the king's body.

sa: ददर्शाथ द्विजः कश्चिद् राजानं प्रस्थितं वनम्। अयाचत क्षुधापन्नः समांसं भोजनं तदा॥
en: A certain Brahmana saw the king roaming in the forest. being hungry, he begged of the king some food with meat.

sa: गन्धर्व उवाच ततो दृष्ट्वाऽऽश्रमपदं रहितं तैः सुतैर्मुनिः। निर्जगाम सुदुःखार्तः पुनरप्याश्रमात् ततः॥
en: The Gandharva said : Seeing his hermitage bereft of his children, the Rishi, afflicted with grief, again came out of it.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा दुष्करं कर्म कृतं भीष्मेण शान्तनुः। स्वच्छन्दमरणं तुष्टो ददौ तस्मै महात्मने॥
en: Having heard the great deed performed by his son Bhishma, Shantanu gave that illustrious man the boon of dying at will.

sa: ऋतावथ महर्षिः स सम्बभूव तया सह। देव्या दिव्येन विधिना वसिष्ठः श्रेष्ठभागृषिः॥
en: The best of Rishis, Vasishtha, made an agreement with her and he united himself with her according to the highest ordinance.

sa: एवमुक्तास्ततः सर्वे राजानस्ते तमूरुजम्। ऊचुः प्रसीदेति तदा प्रसादं च चकार सः॥
en: Having been thus addressed, all the kings addressed that thigh-born child, saying 'Be propitious"; and the child became propitious to them.

sa: संह्लाद इति विख्यातः प्रह्लादस्यानुजस्तु यः। स शल्य इति विख्यातो जज्ञे बाह्रीकपुङ्गवः॥
en: The younger brother of Prahlada who was known as Sanhlada, became among men that best of Balhikas, known as famous Shalya.

sa: आप्लुत्याकाशगङ्गायां देहं त्यक्त्वा स मानुषम्। स्वधर्मनिर्जितं स्थानं स्वर्गे प्राप्य स धर्मराट्॥
en: Then Yudhishthira, after bathing in the celestial Ganga, gave up his human body and gained that state which his acts merited.

sa: तस्मात् त्वमपि भद्रं ते न लोकान् हन्तुमर्हसि। पराशर पराँल्लोकान् जानज्ञानवतां वर॥
en: O Parashara, O foremost of all wise men, you are acquainted with the higher regions, you should not destroy the world.

sa: प्रजोच्छेदमिमं मह्यं न हि कर्तुं त्वमर्हसि। नैष तात द्विजातीनां धर्मो दृष्टस्तपस्विनाम्॥
en: You should not thus destroy all creatures. O sun, it is not a (proper) act for the Brahmanas devoted to asceticism.

sa: अधर्मिष्ठं वसिष्ठेन कृतं चापि पुरा सखे। एतन्मे संशयं सर्वं छेत्तुमर्हसि पृच्छतः॥
en: O friend, was this an act of sin on the part of Vasishtha? I ask, you should remove my these doubts.

sa: ते प्रयाता नरव्याघ्राः सह मात्रा परंतपाः। ब्राह्मणान् ददृशुर्मार्गे गच्छतः संगतान् बहून्॥
en: Those best of men, those chastisers of foes, saw with their mother many Brahmanas on their way going together (towards Panchala).

sa: यदीमां धर्मपत्नीं त्वं मत्तः प्रार्थयसेऽनघ। सत्यवागसि सत्येन समयं कुरु मे ततः॥
en: O sinless one, if you desire to makes her your lawful wife, you are truthful, then truly give me a pledge.

sa: हतेऽभिमन्यौ क्रुद्धेन यत्र पार्थेन संयुगे। अक्षौहिणी: सप्त हत्वा हतो राजा जयद्रथः॥
en: On the death death of Abhimanyu, the destruction by Arjuna of seven Akshauhinis of soldiers alongwith Jayadratha in a great battle.

sa: ऋषय ऊचुः अक्षौहिण्य इति प्रोक्तं यत्त्वया सूतनन्दन। एतदिच्छामहे श्रोतुं सर्वमेव यथातथम्॥
en: The Rishis said : We wish to know, O Son of Suta, all about Akshauhini which you have mentioned to us.

sa: कालो हि कुरुते भावान्सर्वलोके शुभाशुभान्। कालः संक्षिपते सर्वाः प्रजा विसृजते पुनः॥
en: All things, good and bad, in the three worlds, are created by Time. Time destroys them and Time creates them again.

sa: एतद् विदित्वा तुभवान् प्रस्थापयतु पाण्डवान्। द्रष्टुं हि पाण्डुपुत्रांश्च त्वरन्ति कुरवो भृशम्॥
en: Knowing all this, O Sir, permit the Pandavas to go there. The Kurus exceedingly eager to see the sons of Pandu.

sa: तमस्त्वतीव विस्तीर्णं मोह आविशतीव माम्। संज्ञां नोपलभे सूत मनो विह्वलतीव मे॥
en: Utter darkness is all around me, a faintness comes over me. O Suta, consciousness is leaving me, my mind is distracted.

sa: एतत् सर्वं यथावृत्तं विस्तरेण तपोधन। श्रोतुमिच्छामहे ब्रह्मन् परं कौतूहलं हि नः॥
en: O ascetic, O Brahmana, I desire to hear all this in detail as it happened. Our curiosity has become very great.

sa: ततः कदाचिद् ब्रह्माणमुपासांचक्रिरे सुराः। तत्र राजर्षयो ह्यासन् स च राजा महाभिषः॥
en: Once upon a time, the celestials were one day worshipping Brahma. Many royal sages and king Mahabhisha were also present there.

sa: अष्टौ श्लोकसहस्राणि अष्टौ श्लोकशतानि च। अहं वेद्मि शुको वेत्ति संजयो वेत्ति वा न वा॥ तच्छ्लोककूटमद्यापि ग्रथितं सुदृढं मुने। भेत्तुं न शक्यतेऽर्थस्य गूढत्वात्प्रश्रितस्य च॥
en: Sauti continued In this poem there are eight thousand eight hundred verses, whose meaning I know, so does Shuka and perhaps Sanjaya also knows. O Muni, none is able to understand to this day the closely knit slokas for the mysteriousness of their meaning.

sa: तव चापि प्रियं कर्तुमिच्छामि जलचारिणि। अनृतं नोक्तपूर्वं च मया किंचन कर्हिचित्॥
en: O aquatic lady desirous of doing what is agreeable to you. I have never before spoken an untruth in my life.

sa: सा तं दृष्दैव राजानं दुष्यन्तमसितेक्षणा। स्वागतं त इति क्षिप्रमुवाच प्रतिपूज्य च॥
en: No sooner that black-eyed damsel saw the king Dushyanta, that she instantly bade him welcome and worshipped him in due form,

sa: तेऽपि रामस्य तच्छ्रुत्वा नमस्कृत्वा वृषध्वजम्। अश्वमेधं द्विजाः सर्वे पूजयन्ति स्म सर्वशः॥
en: And hearing the words of Rāma, they, too, saluting the deity Rudra, began to speak highly of the ceremony of horse-sacrifice.

sa: सुतो धर्मपरो ब्रह्मज्येष्ठो मम महायशाः। शशबिन्दुरिति ख्यातः स मे राज्यं प्रपत्स्यते॥
en: O Brāhmaṇa, my eldest son, the highly illustrious Sasabindu, the foremost of the pious, shall be the owner of my kingdom.

sa: ईलिनं तु सुतं तंसुर्जनयामास वीर्यवान्। सोऽपि कृत्स्नामिमां भूमिं विजिग्ये जयतां वरः॥
en: Tansu begot a greatly powerful son, named Ilina. He also became the foremost of all conquerors and subjugated the whole world.

sa: देवयान्युवाच आख्यास्याम्यहमादत्स्व वचनं मे नराधिप। शुक्रो नामासुरगुरुः सुतां जानीहि तस्य माम्॥
en: Devayani said : O king, hear my words, Know that I am the daughter of Shukra, the preceptor of the Asuras.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्ते सर्व एवैनं पुत्राः सम्यगुपासते। स च तानात्मजान् सर्वानाश्वासयितुमुद्यतः॥
en: Vaishampayana said: Thereupon all his sons came to worship him. And he too giving them all assurance spoke kindly towards them.

sa: उष्यतां चेह रजनीं सकाशे मम राघव। त्वं हि नारायणः श्रीमांस्त्वयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्।।२८ त्वं प्रभुः सर्वदेवानां पुरुषस्त्वं सनातनः। प्रभाते पुष्पकेण त्वं गन्ता स्वपुरमेव हि॥
en: Do you spend this night with me, O Rāghava. You are the graceful Nārāyaṇa. In you the whole universe is established. You are the lord of all creatures and the eternal Purusha. You shall go to your city next morning in your Pușpaka car.

sa: आहुकं पितरं वृद्धं मातरं च यशस्विनीम्। अभिवाद्य बलं चैव स्थितः कमललोचनः॥
en: Keshava also, having been welcomed by the Chief Yadus with Ugrasena at their head, entered the excellent city (Dwarka) with joy.

sa: प्रतिगृह्य ततः पूजां संपूज्य च महामुनिम्। जग्मुस्ते त्रिदशा हृष्टा नाकपृष्ठं सहानुगाः॥
en: Having accepted his worship and adored in return that great Muni, the immortals, delighted, proceeded to their abodes with their followers.

sa: ममापि परमा प्रीतिर्हदि शत्रुघ्न वर्तते। उपाघ्रास्यामि ते मूर्ध्नि स्नेहस्यैषा परा गतिः॥
en: O Śatrughna, I too have been greatly delighted I therefore smell your crown for this is the best expression of love.

sa: ततो दिव्यममोघं तं जग्राह शरमुत्तमम्। ज्वलन्तं तेजसा घोरं पूरयन्तं दिशो दश॥
en: There upon, he having taken up an excellent arrow of unfailing aim the ten quarters were filled with its native brilliance.

sa: शत्रुघ्नो न तदा जातो यदान्ये निर्जितास्त्वया। तदद्य बाणाभिहतो व्रज त्वं यमसादनम्॥
en: Śatrughna was not born when you did defeat other kings; do you therefore proceed to Death's abode being assailed by shafts.

sa: कुशमुष्टिमुपादाय लवं चैव तु स द्विजः। वाल्मीकिः प्रददौ ताभ्यां रक्षां भूतविनाशिनीम्॥
en: Thereupon taking Kuśa (the upper part of the grass) and Lava (the lower part) the great ascetic Vālmīki made those arrangements.

sa: शतं समधिकं तत्र दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा॥ प्रविष्टं राजभवनं तापसानां महात्मनाम्। ते द्विजाः पूर्णकलशैः सर्वतीर्थाम्बुसत्कृतः॥ गृहीत्वा फलमूलं च रामस्याभ्याहरन्बहु। प्रतिगृह्य तु तत्सर्वं रामः प्रीतिपुरस्कृतः॥ तीर्थोदकानि सर्वाणि फलानि विविधानि च। उवाच च महाबाहुः सर्वानेव महामुनीन्॥
en: And numbering over an hundred, flaming up in their native effulgence, those high-souled anchorites entered the royal residence. And they presented Rāma with various fruits in profusion and vessels filled with sanctified waters of all holy spots. Thereupon, accepting the waters of the holy places as well as the various kinds of fruit, that mighty-armed one spoke to the mighty ascetics.

sa: अम्बिके तव पौत्रस्य दुर्नयात् किल भारतः। सानुबन्धा विनक्ष्यन्ति पौराश्चैवेति नः श्रुतम्॥
en: "O Ambika, have heard that inconsequence of the evil deeds of your grandsons, this Bharata dynasty with its subjects will perish.

sa: अराजके जीवलोके दुर्बला बलवत्तरैः॥ पीड्यन्ते न हि विप्रेषु प्रभुत्वं कस्यचित् तदा।
en: When anarchy begins on Earth, the weak are oppressed by the strong, and no man is master of his own possessions.

sa: ईश्वरेण प्रयत्नेन कारणात् क्षत्रियस्य च। दण्डो दत्तः समानात्मा दण्डो हीदं सनातनम्॥
en: God himself has, with great care, sent Punishment for the use of the Kshatriya. This eternal universe is impartial Punishment's self.

sa: ते सर्वे तावकान् प्रेक्ष्य द्रवतोऽपि पराङ्मुखान्॥ अभ्यवर्तन्त संरब्धान् वृषाञ्जित्वा यथा वृषाः।
en: Although they saw your soldiers flying away from the battle-field those heroes pursued i them like bulls pursuing other angry bulls.

sa: दिष्ट्या तु पुरुषव्याघ्रो बलवान् सत्यविक्रमः। त्वद्गुप्तो नागमत् कृष्ण भीमो बाह्वन्तरं मम॥
en: By good luck, that foremost of men, the mighty Bhima of true prowess, protected by you, came not within my embrace.

sa: पीडितं वीक्ष्य राजानं सोदर्या भरतर्षभ। महत्या सेनया सार्धं परिवः स्म पार्षतम्॥
en: Seeing the king thus assailed, O foremost of Bharatas, his brothers, accompanied by a large force, surrounded the son of Prishata.

sa: एवं चित्रमभूद् युद्धं तस्य तैः सह भारत॥ उत्थायोत्थाय हि यथा देहिनामिन्द्रयैर्विभो।
en: That battle between him and them was indeed wonderful because it resembled the struggles, O king, between men and their Senses.

sa: गान्धारी च नृपश्रेष्ठ सर्वांश्च कुरुयोषितः॥ पतिताः सहसा भूमौ श्रुत्वा क्रूरं वचस्तदा।
en: Gandhari also, O best of kings and all the Kuru ladies, suddenly fell down on the ground, hearing those cruel words.

sa: कृतमित्येव दैत्येन्द्रमुवाच स च वै द्विजः। प्रह्लादस्त्वब्रवीत् प्रीतो गृह्यतां वर इत्युत॥
en: The Brahmana answered the king of the Asuras saying,-Very well. I will obey you.-Prahlada, pleased with him, said,-Take what you wish.

sa: अभिप्रजाता सा तत्र पुत्रमेकं सुवर्चसम्। समकालं च राज्ञोऽपि देव्यां पुत्रो व्यजायत॥
en: While residing there, she brought forth a highly effulgent young one. simultancously the king also beget on his queen a son.

sa: स तु कामान्मृगो राजन्नासाद्यासाद्य तं नृपम्। पुनरभ्येति जवनो जवेन महता ततः॥
en: Possessed of great fleetness the animal, at its will, appearing now and then before the king, ran on with great quickness.

sa: स तथा सर्वतो रुद्धः सर्वत्र भयदर्शनः॥ अभवद् भयसंतप्तश्चक्रे च परमां मतिम्।
en: Beset with danger, and seeing fear on all sides, the mouse, stricken with fear for his safety, made a high resolution.

sa: ते सर्वे स्वर्गते तस्मिंस्तस्य पुत्रानपूजयन्। तेषां तु कर्मणा राजंस्तथा चाध्ययनेन च॥
en: Those kings, however, O king, that were the disciples of Gautama, continued to worship Gautama's sons after his ascension to heaven.

sa: प्रतिज्ञातं च भीमेन द्यूतकाले धनंजय। ऊरू भेत्स्यामि ते संख्ये गदयेति सुयोधनम्॥
en: At the time of the gambling, O Dhananjaya, Bhima promised to break the thighs of Suyodhana with his mace in battle.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच गते भगवति व्यासे धृतराष्ट्रो महीपतिः। किमचेष्टत विप्रर्षे तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: Janamejaya said After the holy Vyasa had gone away, what, O Rishi, did king Dhritarashtra do? You should tell me this.

sa: समतां वसुधायाश्च स सम्यगुदपादयत्। वैषम्यं हि परं भूमेरासीदिति च नः श्रुतम्॥
en: We have heard that the surface of the earth had before been very uneven. It was Prithu who levelled its surface.

sa: दिलीपं च महात्मानं मृतं संजय शुश्रुम। यस्य कर्माणि भूरीणि कथयन्ति द्विजातयः॥
en: We hear, O Srinjaya, that the great Dilipa also met with death. The Brahmanas take pleasure in recounting his innumerable deeds.

sa: यदीमां भवतो बुद्धिं विद्याम वयमीदृशीम्। शस्त्रं नैव ग्रहीष्यामो न वधिष्याम कंचन॥
en: If we knew that this was your intention, we would then have never taken up arms and killed a single creature.

sa: इन्द्रोऽग्निरर्यमा चैव यत्र प्राक् प्रीतिमाप्नुवन्। तं देशं कारपवनाद् यमुनायां जगाम ह॥
en: From Karavapana he proceeded to that spot on the Yamuna where formerly Indra and Agni and Aryaman had obtained great felicity.

sa: नित्यं स्वाहा स्वधा नित्यं चोभे मानुषदैवते। पुढेष्वाशासते नित्यं पितरो दैवतानि च।॥
en: The offerings with Svaha and Svadha in Shraddhas and sacrifices are always solicited from children by the Pitris and the deities.

sa: मायया सलिलं स्तभ्य यत्राभूत् ते स्थितः सुतः। अत्यद्भुतेन विधिना दैवयोगेन भारत॥
en: Making the waters solid by means of his wonderful power of illusion, your son Duryodhana, O Bharata, lived within that lake.

sa: नूनं व्यपकृतं किंचिन्मया पूर्वेषु जन्मसु॥ येन मां दुःखभागेषु धाता कर्मसु युक्तवान्।
en: Forsooth, I committed great sins in my previous lives, for which the great God has made me suffer such a grief.

sa: सिंहनादांश्च बहुशः शृणु घोरान् भयावहान्। तस्माद् याहि शनैः सूत जघनं परिपालय॥
en: Hear, those various leonine roars that are so awful and loud. Therefore, O driver, move slowly and wait in the rear.

sa: शक्रतुल्यबलाः सर्वे यथावध्यन्त पाण्डवैः॥ दृष्ट्वैव च पुरे राजञ्जन: सर्वः स संजयम्।
en: Alas! Time is powerful! Difficult are his ways, since all our men powerful like Indra, have been killed by the Pandavas.

sa: आकुलानि च शास्त्राणि हेतुभिश्चिन्तितानि च। निश्चयश्चैव यो मन्त्रे वेदाहं तं यथाविधि॥
en: The scriptures are conflicting and their conclusions are based upon reasons. The truth of the mantras is duly known to me.

sa: तस्मात् तु पितृलोकं तं व्रजन्तं सोऽन्वपश्यत। पितृलोकाच तं यान्तं याम्यं लोकमपश्यत॥
en: He next saw him proceed to the region of the Pitris. Devala saw him then proceed to the region of Yama.

sa: तत्राद्भुतं परं चक्रे शल्यः शत्रुनिबर्हणः। यदेकः समरे शूरो योधयामास वै बहून्॥
en: Shalya, that slayer of foes, performed a wonderful deed because that hero, Alone, unaided, fought with many arrows in that battle.

sa: तस्यैव तु मनुष्यस्य सा सा बुद्धिस्तदा तदा। कालयोगे विपर्यासं प्राप्यान्योन्यं विपद्यते॥
en: Again the opinions of the same persons, overwhelmed with reverses bought on by the influence of time, become opposed to another.

sa: पञ्चालानां यथा सर्वे निहताः सपदानुगाः। धृष्टद्युम्नः शिखण्डी च द्रौपद्याः पञ्च चात्मजाः॥
en: Tell me how all the Panchalas with their followers and Dhrishtadyumna and Shiklandhin and the five sons of Draupadi, were killed.

sa: न च पीडयितव्यो मे भीष्मो धर्मभृतां वरः॥ अतः पुरःसराश्चापि निवर्तन्तु धनंजय।
en: That best or righteous person viz., Bhishma, should not be vexed. Let not the guards, therefore, O Dhananjaya accompany us today.

sa: यस्य ब्राह्मणसात् सर्वं वित्तमासीन्महात्मनः। नादेयं ब्राह्मणेष्वासीद् यस्य स्वमपि जीवितम्॥ सदा स्त्रीणां प्रियो नित्यं दाता चैव महारथः। स वै पार्थास्त्रनिर्दग्धो गतः परमिकां गतिम्॥
en: His wealth was always given to the Brahmanas. There was nothing not even his life which he could not make over to the Brahmanas. He was a darling of women, generous and a great car-warrior. Such a highminded man met with death,

sa: एकाकी भरतश्रेष्ठ ततो दुर्योधनो नृपः॥ नापश्यत् समरे कंचित् सहायं रथिनां वरः।
en: Meanwhile, O chief of the Bharatas, king Duryodhana, that best of car-warriors, did not find a single warrior on his side.

sa: तथैव पाण्डवा राजन् व्यूह्य सैन्यं महारणे॥ अभ्ययुः कौरवान् राजन् योत्स्यमानाः समन्ततः।
en: Similarly, all the Pandavas, having arranged their soldiers in that great battle, proceeded against the Kauravas, O king, fighting with them.

sa: पश्य कर्णस्य पत्नीं त्वं वृषसेनस्य मातरम्। लालप्यमानां करुणं रुदतीं पतितां भुवि।॥
en: Behold, the wife of Karna and mother of Vrishasena, is bewailing piteously and crying and weeping and falling upon the ground.

sa: स तु वने वरं देवांस्त्रातुमर्हथ मामितः॥ यश्चेहोपस्पृशेत् कूपे स सोमपगतिं लभेत्।
en: He also said-"Let him that bathes in this well, achieve the end that is attained by persons that have drunk Soma.'

sa: भग्नाक्षयुगचक्रेषाः केचिदासन्विशांपते। अन्येषां सायकाः क्षीणास्तथान्ये बाणपीडिताः॥ अक्षता युगपत् केचित् प्राद्रवन् भयपीडितः।
en: The arrows of some were exhausted. Some were assailed with arrows. Some, though unwounded, fled in a body, stricken with fear.

sa: संजय उवाच अन्योयं परिरक्षामो यत्नेन महता नृप।॥ एवं सर्वेऽनुसंचिन्त्य प्रययुर्यत्र सैनिकाः।
en: O king, we shall protect one another very carefully. Accepting Shakuani's view all the Kauravas then proceeded where the Madras were.

sa: हत्वा तु समरे पार्थः सहस्रे द्वे परंतपः॥ रथानां सवरूथानां विधूमोऽग्निरिव ज्वलन्।
en: Having destroyed two thousand cars with their fences, that scorcher of foes, Partha, appeared like a smokeless fire with blazing flames.

sa: किं वाचा बहुनोक्तेन कत्थितेन च दुर्मते। वाणी सम्पद्यतामेषा कर्मणा मा चिरं कृथाः॥ तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा सर्व एवाभ्यपूजयन्। राजानः सोमकाश्चैव ये तत्रासन् समागताः॥
en: What is the use of long talks and idle brag, O wicked man! Carry out these words of yours into acts! Do not delay at all!—Hearing these words of his, the Somakas and the other kings that were present there, all praised them highly.

sa: कर्णं तु निहतं दृष्ट्वा शत्रुभिः परमाहवे। भीता दिशो व्यकीर्यन्त तावकाः क्षतविक्षताः॥
en: Hearing that the heroic Karna had been killed by his enemy your soldiers, overcome with fear, fled away on all sides.

sa: आधिभिर्दह्यमानाया मति: संचलिता मम॥ सा मे व्यवस्थिता श्रुत्वा तव वाक्यं जनार्दन।
en: My heart, burning in grief, had been unfixed. After hearing what you said, however, that heart, O Janarddana, has been settled.

sa: तस्मिन् काले प्रमुक्तस्त्वं तरुमेवाधिरोक्ष्यसे। न हि ते जीवितादन्यत् किंचित् कृत्यं भविष्यति॥
en: Freed then, you will get upon the tree and not think of anything else except the safety of your own life.

sa: हत्वा भ्रातॄन् वयस्यांश्च पितॄन् पुत्रान् सुहृद्गणान्। बन्धूनमात्यान् पौत्रांश्च जित्वा सर्वाञ्जिता वयम्॥
en: Having killed brothers and friends, fathers, sons, well-wishers, kinsmen, counsellors, and having defeated them all, we ourselves are defeated at last.

sa: सम्बन्धिनोऽतिथीन् भृत्यान् संश्रितांश्चैव यो भृशम्। सम्मानयति सत्कृत्य स मा पृच्छतु पाण्डवः॥
en: Let the son of Pandu, who always by his favour honours his relative and guests and servants and dependants, question me.

sa: स तैः परिवृतो राजा नक्षत्रैरिव चन्द्रमाः। धृतराष्ट्र पुरस्कृत्य स्वपुरं प्रविवेश ह॥
en: Surrounded by them all like the moon by the stars, the king, placing Dhritarashtra at the head started for the city.

sa: चतुर्भिश्च चतुर्भिश्च द्वाभ्यां पञ्चभिरेव च। हूयते च पुनर्वाभ्यां तस्मै होमात्मने नमः॥
en: Libations are poured on the Homa fire accompanied with seventeen Mantras. You are the soul of the Homa. Salutations to you.

sa: अश्वान् राजन् मनुष्यांश्च रजसा संवृते सति। भूमौ निपतिताश्चान्ये वमन्तो रुधिरं बहु॥
en: Others dropped down on the earth vomiting blood profusely. Many warriors, entangled with one another by their locks, could not move.

sa: यद् यदेवंगतेनाद्य शक्यं कर्तुं मया तव। तदाज्ञापय कर्तास्मि संधिरेवास्तु नौ सखे।॥
en: Whatever I can do, tell me and I shall do it for your. Let there be peace between us, O friend.

sa: ततस्तां वीरुधं सोमं संकल्प्य सुमहातपाः। ऋचो यजूषिं सामानि मनसा चिन्तयन् मुनिः॥
en: The great ascetic took the creeper for the Soma plant. He then mentally uttered the Rich's, the Yayushes and the Samans.

sa: ववृधे स यथाकालं सरसीव महोत्पलम्। बभूव काञ्चनष्ठीवी यथार्थं नाम तस्य तत्॥
en: The child grew up like a large lotus in a lake, and became Suvarnashthivin in reality as well as in name.

sa: न त्यागो न पुनर्यज्ञो न तपो मनुजेश्वर। क्षत्रियस्य विधीयन्ते न परस्वोपजीवनम्॥
en: Neither Renunciation, nor Sacrifice, nor Penances, nor dependence on the wealth of others, O king, has been laid down for Kshatriyas.

sa: सुखमेवहि दुःखान्तं कदाचिद् दुःखतः सुखम्। तस्मादेतद् द्वयं जह्याद् य इच्छेच्छाश्वतं सुखम्॥
en: Happiness always ends in sorrow and sometimes originates from sorrow itself. He, therefore, who desires perpetual happiness must give up both.

sa: नारायणः परं ब्रह्म नारायणपरं तपः। नारायणः परो देवः सर्वं नारायणः सदा।।१००।
en: The Vedas are devoted to Narayana. Penances are devoted to Narayana. The gods are devoted to Narayana. Everything else is Narayana.

sa: दण्डनीत्यां यदा राजा सम्यक् कात्स्न्येन वर्तते। तदा कृतयुगं नाम कालसृष्टं प्रवर्तते॥
en: When the king rules depending entirely on the science of punishment the foremost of ages called Krita is then said flourish.

sa: नर्दतामसुराणां च ध्वनिमें श्रोत्रमागतः। न रतस्य च संग्रामे क्रोशतोऽपि स्वनो गुरोः॥
en: And roars of Asuras also reached my ears; but I could not hear the cries of my superior, engaged in conflict.

sa: ते च कर्मान्तिकाः सर्वे वसिष्ठाय महर्षये। सर्वं निवेदयन्ति स्म यज्ञे यदुपकल्पितम्॥
en: Then the servants came and informed the intelligent Vasiştha as to the articles that had been got ready for the sacrifice.

sa: ततो रामो जलं स्पृष्ट्वा प्रहृष्टवदनः शुचिः॥ प्रतिजग्राह ते विद्ये महर्षे वितात्मनः।
en: Thereat Rāma with a cheerful countenance sipning water with a purified body received those sciences from the Maharși of subdued soul.

sa: एतस्य मृगरत्नस्य परायें काञ्चनत्वचि। उपवेक्ष्यति वैदेही मया सह सुमध्यमा॥ न कादली न प्रियकी न प्रवेणी न चाविकी। भवेदेतस्य सदृशी स्पर्शेऽनेनेति मे मतिः॥
en: Vaidehi of slender waist desire to sit with me on the exquisitely fine golden skin of this gem of a deer, me-seems no deer skin is so comfortable to touch as this neither the skin of Kādali, Priyaki, Praveni nor of Caviki.

sa: तानि चास्त्राणि वेत्त्येष यथावत् कुशिकात्मजः। अपूर्वाणां च जनने शक्तो भूयश्च धर्मवित्॥
en: Kuśika's son is adequately conversant with all those weapons. And that one knowing duty is also capable of creating wonderful weapons.

sa: भ्रातुस्ते वदतः पुत्र लक्ष्मणस्य श्रुतं त्वया। यदत्रानन्तरं तत्त्वं कुरुष्व यदि रोचते॥
en: You have heard, Oh my son, what your brother Laksmana said; and if you like, do what seems reasonable to you.

sa: यावदेव न जानाति कश्चिदर्थमिमं नरः। तावदेव मया सार्धमात्मस्थं कुरु शासनम् ॥
en: Ere people come to know this proposal of exile, do you secure the government of the kingdom to yourself with me.

sa: वयं परिचरिष्यामः सीता यूयं च राघवम्। इति पौरस्त्रियो भर्तृन् दुःखार्तास्तत्तदब्रुवन् ॥
en: We and you, will serve Sītā, and Rāghava. Thus afflicted with grief, the women of the city spoke to their husbands.

sa: तीव्रमुत्पादितं दुःखं भ्रातृणां मे तथा पितुः। यथा सेयं नृशंसस्य कर्मणः फलमश्नुताम्॥
en: This one has occasioned intense misery to my father and brothers Let her now take the fruit of her fell deed.

sa: परा त्वत्तो गतिर्वीर पृथिव्यां नोपपद्यते। परिपालय नः सर्वान् राक्षसेभ्यो नृपात्मज ॥
en: O hero, we have no greater refuge on earth than yourself. Do you, O king's son, rescues us all from Raksasas.

sa: गतेषु वानरेन्द्रेषु रामः सुग्रीवमब्रवीत्। कथं भवान् विजानीते सर्वं वै मण्डलं भुवः॥
en: On the monkey-chiefs having departed, Rāma said to Sugrīva, How is it that you know all the quarters of this earth?'

sa: सत्यं तु प्रतिजानामि त्यज शोकमरिंदम। करिष्यामि तथा यत्नं यथा प्राप्स्यसि मैथिलीम्॥
en: O vanquisher of foes, leave off sorrowing. I promise to you truly, I will exert so that you mayst obtain Maithilī.

sa: इदं च ब्रह्मणा दत्तं हैमायै वनमुत्तमम्॥ शाश्वतः कामभोगश्च गृहं चेदं हिरण्मयम्।
en: Then Brahmä conferred on Hemā this fine forest and this golden mansion, with the perpetual privilege of enjoying every pleasure herein.

sa: ततः पौरजनः सर्वः श्रुत्वा रामाभिषेचनम्। प्रभातां रजनीं दृष्ट्वा चक्रे शोभयितुं पुरीम्॥
en: Then the citizens, hearing of the installation of Rāma and seeing that the night had departed, fell to adorning the city.

sa: अतीव सा तु संतुष्टा कैकेयी विस्मयान्विता। दिव्यमाभरणं तस्यै कुब्जायै प्रददौ शुभम्॥
en: Inspired with exceeding joy, Kaikey7, struck with surprise, made to the hump-backed woman a present of an excellent and elegant ornament.

sa: एकैकं पादपं गुल्म लतां वा पुष्पशालिनीम्। अदृष्टरूपां पश्यन्ती रामं पप्रच्छ साऽबला॥
