en: Seeing every tree and shrub crowned with blossoms unseen before, that one belonging to the softer see questioned Rāma about it.

sa: तं रामः पुरुषव्याघ्रो लक्ष्मणं प्रत्युवाच ह। अङ्गावेक्षस्व सौमित्रे कस्येमां मन्यसे चमूम्॥
en: Thereat, Rāma-chief of men, answered Lakş mana, saying O son of Sumitra, do you (first) ascertain whom this host belongs to.

sa: बलाद् व्यापादयांचक्रे ननदं च महास्वनम्। श्रोत्राभ्यामथ रक्तं तु तस्य सुस्राव पात्यतः॥
en: Alha beliowing a thundering voice, Vali crushed (him) down. And blood began to trickle down from the pores of his ears.

sa: सीतां प्राप्स्यति धर्मात्मा वधिष्यति च रावणम्। सहायमात्रेण मया राघवः स्वेन तेजसा।७।।
en: By virtue of native energy, and merely with my help, the righteous Rāghava shall recover Sītā and slay Rāvana to boot.

sa: लक्ष्मणानय दारूणि दृढानि च वराणि च। कुरुष्वावसथं सौम्य वासे मेऽभिरतं मनः॥
en: O Lakşmaņa, bring you wood good and strong. O amiable one, construct a dwelling. My mind is set upon staying here.

sa: कथयस्व ममोपायं केनोपायेन मन्थरे। भरतः प्राप्नुयाद् राज्यं न तु रामः कथंचन॥
en: Do you tell me the means. By what means, O Mantharā, Bharata will gain the kingdom, and in no wise Rāma.

sa: बहुशः स तु निःश्वस्य रामो राजीवलोचनः। हा प्रियेति विचुक्रोश बहुशो वाष्पगद्गदः॥
en: And sobbing again and again the lotus-eyed Rāma bewailed with his voice choked with the vapour of grief, exclaiming “Ah Sītā!”

sa: अशुभं वत मन्येऽहं गोमायुर्वाशते यथा। स्वस्ति स्यादपि वैदेह्या राक्षसैर्भक्षणं विना ॥
en: Ah! I consider this as inauspicious—that these jackals are crying. Escaping being devoured by the Raksasas, may fair fortune befall Vaidehi!

sa: अहं किं चापि वक्ष्यामि देवीं तव सुतो मया। नीतोऽसौ मातुलकुलं संतापं मा कृथा इति॥ असत्यमपि नैवाहं ब्रूयां वचनमीदृशम्। कथमप्रियमेवाहं ब्रूयां सत्यमिदं वचः॥
en: Shall I say to the worshipful one, 'I have conveyed your son to the home of his maternal uncle. Do you not grieve.' I will never tell such a lie. Yet how can I speak this truth which is so very unpleasant?

sa: पुरा भ्रातः पिता नः स मातरं ते समुद्वहन्। मातामहे समाश्चौषीद् राज्यशुल्कमनुत्तमम्॥
en: O brother, formerly when our father espoused the hand of your mother, he promised her the kingdom as her marriage portion.

sa: बिभेद च पुनस्तालान् सप्तैकेन महेषुणा। गिरिं रसातलं चैव जनयन् प्रत्ययं तदा॥
en: With a single mighty shaft he pierced seven palmyra palms, a hill, and the sixth nether worlds, carrying conviction to Sugriva.

sa: सा विरुपा महाघोरा राक्षसी शोणितोक्षिता। ननाद विविधान् नादान् यथा प्रावृषि तोयदः॥
en: And being deformed, and covered with gore, the dreadful Rākşasī sent up many a roar, like clouds rumbling in the rains.

sa: स किष्किन्धां प्रविश्य त्वं ब्रूहि वानरपुङ्गवम्। मूर्ख ग्राम्यसुखे सक्तं सुग्रीवं वचनान्मम॥
en: Do you therefore repair to Kişkindhā and speak of me to that stupid lord of monkeys Sugriva, addicted to rural enjoyments.

sa: तेषु सर्वेषु दुर्गेषु सरस्सु च सरित्सु च। रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यस्ततस्ततः॥
en: In all these, difficult of access, as also in rivers and tanks, you should thoroughly search for Rāvana along with Vaidehī.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा परमप्रीतो विश्वामित्रो महाबलः। प्रणतो विनयाद् वीरो वसिष्ठं जपतां वरम्॥
en: Upon seeing that foremost of these reciting mantras, the highly powerful and heroic Viśvāmitra, exceedingly delighted, bowed to him in humility.

sa: मनोरथोऽयमिष्टोऽस्या भगिन्या मम राक्षसाः। शीघ्रं सम्पाद्यतां गत्वा तौ प्रमथ्य स्वतेजसा ॥
en: You Rākşasas, even this is my sister's dear desire. Repairing thither, specdily accomplish this, bearing them down by your native might.

sa: यस्य कोशश्च दण्डश्च मित्राण्यात्मा च भूमिप। समान्येतानि सर्वाणि स राज्यं महदश्नुते॥
en: O king, truly does he attain to a vast kingdom, who has the same wealth, soldiery and body with his friends.

sa: एवं शापं मयि न्यस्य विलप्य करुणं बहु। चितामारोप्य देहं तन्मिथुनं स्वर्गमभ्ययात्॥
en: Having thus inflicted on me the curse and piteously lamented long, the coupe ascended the funeral pile and went to heaven.

sa: तस्मादन्यत्र गच्छाम इति संचिन्त्य राघवः। प्रातिष्ठत स वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणेन च संगतः॥
en: Therefore will I go to another quarter. Having settled this in his mind, Rāghava departed along with Videha's daughter and Laksmana.

sa: यदा समेता बहवस्त्वया राजर्षयः सह। कथयिष्यन्ति धर्मज्ञ तत्र किं प्रतिवक्ष्यसि ॥
en: When, O you versed in duty, the Rajarsis assembled around you shall ask you regarding this matter, what will you answer?

sa: आश्रमं प्रतियाते तु खरे खरपराक्रमे। तानेवौत्पातिकान् रामः सह भ्रात्रा ददर्श ह॥
en: When Khara of fierce prowess had come to the asylum Rāma in company with his brother saw all those evil prognostics.

sa: नारदस्य तु तद् वाक्यं श्रुत्वा वाक्यविशारदः। पूजयामास धर्मात्मा सह शिष्यो महामुनिम्॥
en: Hearing those words of Nārada, that one of virtuous soul, skilled in speech, together with his disciples, worshipped that great sage.

sa: श्वः प्रभाते महातेजो द्रष्टुमर्हसि मां पुनः। स्वागतं जपतां श्रेष्ठ मामनुज्ञातुमर्हसि ॥
en: To-morrow morning, O highly energetic one, you will see me again. Welcome, best of reciters. It behove you to favour me.

sa: तदिदं मेऽनुसम्प्राप्तं देवि दुःखं स्वयंकृतम्। सम्मोहादिह बालेन यथा स्याद् भक्षितं विषम्॥
en: Therefore, O noble dame, I have myself brought this misfortune on me, like a child who has eaten poison through ignorance.

sa: पूर्वं कृतयुगे तात पर्वताः पक्षिणोऽभवन्। तेऽपि जग्मुर्दिशः सर्वा गरुडा इव वेगिनः॥
en: O worshipful one, in olden times, the mountains, gifted with wings, began to range all quarters with velocity like to Garuda.

sa: यावद् रामस्य च कथा त्वत्कृता प्रचरियति ॥ तावदूर्ध्वमधश्च त्वन मल्लोकेषु निवत्स्यसि।
en: As long as this story of Rāmāyaṇa shall retain its currency, you shall reside both in this world and in mine.

sa: स तदासादितस्तेन कपिना पर्वतोत्तमः। बुद्ध्वा तस्य हरेर्वेगं जहर्ष च ननाद च॥
en: Being thus crushed down by that monkey, the best of mountains, being apprized of his prowess, began to shout with joy.

sa: इदं पवित्रं पापघ्नं पुण्यं वेदैश्च सम्मितम्। यः पठेत् रामचरितं सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥
en: He that reads this sacred, sin-destroying, merit-bestowing history of Rāma like that of the Veda itself, becomes cleansed from all sin.

sa: अस्ति मूलफलं चैतनिषादैः स्वयमर्जितम्। आर्द्र शुष्कं तथा मांसं वन्यं चोच्चावचं तथा॥
en: Here are fruits and roots gathered by the Nişādas and meat dry and moist and various other produces of the forest.

sa: किमुवाच वचो रामः किमुवाच च लक्ष्मणः। सुमन्त्र वनमासाध किमुवाच च मैथिली॥
en: And what did Rāma say? And what did Laks mana? And, O Sumantra, arriving at the forest what did Mithila's daughter?

sa: वेदाः सहाङ्गा विद्याश्च यथा ह्यात्मभुवं प्रभुम्। ब्रह्माणं बोधयन्त्यद्य तथा त्वां बोधयाम्यहम्॥
en: And even as the Vedas with the Angas and other lore indoctrinate the self-create lord Brahmā, so do I enlighten you.

sa: नागाश्च तुष्टुवुर्यक्षा रक्षांसि विविधानि च। प्रेक्ष्य सर्वे कपिवरं सहसा विगतक्लमम् ॥
en: Nagas and Yaksas, and various (races of) Raksasas, eulogized (him), on beholding that tiger-like monkey, Hanumān, in the act of bounding.

sa: यदि दृष्ट्वा त्वया जम्बो जाम्बूनदसमप्रभा। प्रियां यदि विजानासि निःशङ्कं कथयस्व मे॥
en: Do you tell me without fear, O Jāmbu, if you have seen my dear one resembling in hue the river Jāmbu.

sa: स तु संविश्य मेदिन्यां महार्हशयनोचितः। इमाः सौमित्रये रामो व्याजहार कथाः शुभाः॥
en: Saying this, Rāma lying down on the ground although worthy of a costly bed, spoke these excellent words to Sumitrā's son.

sa: त्वं तार शिबिकां शीघ्रमादायागच्छ सम्भ्रमात्। त्वरा गुणवती युक्ता ह्यस्मिन् काले विशेषतः॥
en: O Tārā, do you go and bring soon a conveyance; for speediness is a special virtue on an occasion like this.

sa: मम भर्ता महातेजा वयसा पञ्चविंशकः॥ अष्टादश हि वर्षाणि मम जन्मनि गण्यते।
en: Then the highly effulgent Răma, my husband was twenty-five years old, and myself was eighteen years old counting from my birth.

sa: त्वया विरहिता देवी लक्ष्मणेन च राघव। ह्रियमाणा मया दृष्टा रावणेन बलीयसा॥
en: I saw her, O Rāghava, carried away stealthily by the powerful Rāvaņa, in your absence as well as that of Lakşmaņa.

sa: आत्मा हि दाराः सर्वेषां दारसंग्रहवर्तिनाम्। आत्मेयमिति रामस्य पालयिष्यति मेदिनीम्॥ पादपैः सह।
en: Of all those that marry, the wife is the (other) soul. Șītā will govern the earth, as she is Rāma's self.

sa: न मेऽस्ति संशयो वीर सर्वथा जनकात्मजा ॥ विनष्टा भक्षिता वापि राक्षसैर्वनचारिभिः।
en: I make no doubt, O hero, but that Janaka's daughter has either been slain or devoured by Rākṣasas ranging the forest.

sa: उत्थाय च महातेजाः प्रकृतीस्ता निशाम्य च। अब्रवीद् भ्रातरं रामो लक्ष्मणं पुण्यलक्षणम्॥
en: Rising (from his bed), that highly energetic one, Rāma, viewing the subjects (asleep), addressed his brother Lakşmana graced with auspicious marks.

sa: धौम्यो रौद्राणि सामानि याम्यानि च विशाम्पते। गायन् गच्छति मार्गेषु कुशानादाय पाणिना॥
en: O king, Dhaumya proceeds along with Kusha grass in hand, uttering the fearful Mantras of the Sama Veda relating to Yama.

sa: यां श्रियं सुहृदश्चैव दुर्हदश्च विशाम्पते। पश्यन्ति पुरुषे दीप्तां सा समर्था भवत्युत॥
en: O king, that blazing prosperity which is seen by one's both friend and foe is considered to be the real prosperity.

sa: निकृत: स ततो भ्रात्रा कस्मिश्चित् कारणान्तरे। ऋष्यमूके मया सार्धं सुग्रीवो न्यवसच्चिरम्॥
en: For some cause Sugriva was driven out by his brother and lived for a long time with me at the Hrishvamukha.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच यदिदं शोचितं राज्ञाधृतराष्ट्रेण वै मुरे। प्रव्राज्य पाण्डवान् वीरान् सर्वमेतन्निरर्थकम्॥
en: Janamejaya said : O (Muni), king Dhritarashtra must uselessly have lamented after having sent the heroic sons of Pandu into exile.

sa: संतता गतिरेतस्य नैष तिष्ठति पाण्डव। आदायैव तु भूतानां तेजो विसृजते पुनः॥
en: O Pandava his course is unremitting and he never rests. And withdrawing the energy of (all) creatures, he gives it back.

sa: एष्टव्या बहवः पुत्रा यद्येकोऽपि गयां व्रजेत्। यजेत वाश्वमेधेन नीलं वा वृषमुत्सृजेत्॥
en: One should desire for many sons, so that one may go to Gaya or perform Ashvamedha or offer a Nila bull.

sa: तास्तदा प्रत्यभाषन्त रासभाः सर्वतो दिशः॥ प्रातिष्ठत ततो भीष्मो द्रोणेन सह संजय।
en: Asses from all directions began to bray in response (to the jackal). O Sanjaya, then left the assembly Bhisma, Drona with

sa: ततः स कथयामास दृष्ट्वा हंसस्य किल्बिषम्। तेषां परमदुःखार्तः स पक्षी सर्वपक्षिणाम्॥
en: Having witnessed the sinful act of the swan, that bird spoke of it to all the other birds in great sorrow.

sa: भीमसेनार्जुनौ चोभौ माद्रेयौ च मया सह। त्यजेस्त्वमिति मे बुद्धिर्न तुधर्मं परित्यजेः॥
en: You can abandon Bhimasena, Arjuna these twin sons of Madri along with myself, I think, but you can never renounce virtue.

sa: अकर्मणां वै भूतानां वृत्तिः स्यान्न हि काचन। तदेवाभिप्रपद्येत न विहन्यात् कदाचन॥
en: The course of life for a creatures that does not act is impossible; for them there is action and never inaction.

sa: शरभङ्गाश्रमं गत्वा शुकस्य च महात्मनः। न दुर्गतिमवाप्नोति पुनाति च कुलं नरः॥
en: Going to the hermitage called Sharbhanga of the high-souled Shukra, a man never meets with any calamity and sanctifies his race.

sa: धाराणां च निपातेन वायोर्विस्फूर्जितेन च। गर्जितेन च दैत्यानां न प्राज्ञायत किंचन॥
en: (And) I was quite bewildered on account of that (heavy) downpour, blowing of the wind and the yell of the Daityas.

sa: निदेशे हि मया तुभ्यं स्थातव्यमनसूयता। वृद्धिर्हि मया प्राप्ता त्वत्कृते हि मयानघ॥
en: O sinless one, as I have grown to this size through your favour, I shall cheerfully do what you command me."

sa: जगत् सर्वमजय्यं चापि सर्वशः। महाभूतात्मकं ब्रह्म नातः परतरं भवेत्॥ इदं विश्वं
en: This whole universe, which is unconquerable and which abounds in great elements, is Brahma (himself). There is nothing high than this.

sa: यस्मात् तु लोके दृश्यन्ते क्षमिणः पृथिवीसमाः। तस्माज्जनम् च भूतानां भवश्च प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: Because persons forgiving like the earth are seen in this world, it is therefore that creatures are born and enjoy prosperity.

sa: स तत्र तेन मनसा बभूव क्षुभितेन्द्रियः। पत्नीदृष्ट्वा द्विजेन्द्राणां वह्निः कामवशं ययौ।॥
en: Seeing the wives of those foremost of Brahmanas with eager eyes, his mind became greatly agitated; he was filled with desires.

sa: तच्च वाक्यं तथा सर्वे तत्र तत्र विशाम्यते। श्रावयांचक्रिरे विप्रा दमयन्त्या यथेरितम्॥
en: O ruler of the earth, all the Brahmanas repeated the words, wherever they wandered, which Damayanti had enjoined them to do.

sa: पापं चिन्तयते चैव ब्रवीति च करोति च। तस्याधर्मप्रवृत्तस्य गुणा नश्यन्ति साधवः॥
en: They commit sin in thought, in word and also in action. Addicted to evil ways, all their good qualities are destroyed.

sa: सर्वं व्याप्तमिदं ब्रह्मन् प्राणिभिः प्राणिजीवनैः। मत्स्यान् चसन्ते मत्स्याश्च तत्र किं प्रतिभाति ते॥ सत्त्वैः सत्त्वानि जीवन्ति बहुधा द्विजसत्तम। प्राणिनोऽन्योन्यभक्षाश्च तत्र किं प्रतिभाति ते॥
en: O Brahmana, the whole universe is full of animals and animal organisms. Do you not see that fish preys upon fish and various other species of animals prey on various other animals and there are also some who prey upon one another.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच धृतराष्ट्रस्य तद् वाक्यं निशम्य शकुनिस्तदा। दुर्योधनमिदं काले कर्णेन सहितोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard those words of Dhritarashtra, Shakuni, when he got an opportunity through Karna, spoke thus to Duryodhana.

sa: साब्रवीद् वणिज: सर्वान् सार्थवाहं च तं ततः। क्व नु यास्यति सार्थोऽयमेतदाख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: Thereupon she asked the merchants and the leader of the caravan, “You ought to tell me wither the caravan is going.'

sa: तपसश्च मनुं पुत्रं भानु चाप्यङ्गिराः सृजत्। बृहद्भानुं तु तं प्राहुर्ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः॥
en: Angira also created the Prajapati Bhanu, the son of Tapa. He is also called Brihadbhanu by Brahmanas learned in the Vedas.

sa: एवं शास्त्रेषु भिन्नेषु बहुधा नीयते क्रिया। तपोदानप्रवृत्ता च राजसी भवति प्रजा॥
en: The Shastras having been thus divided, (religious) acts also (naturally) multiplied. Mostly influenced by passion, men engaged in asceticism and gifts.

sa: नातप्ततपसा शक्य एष दिव्यो महारथः। द्रष्टुं वाप्यथवा स्प्रष्टुमारोढुं कुत एव च॥
en: He who has not acquired ascetic merit is not capable of seeing and touching this excellent car far from riding it.

sa: हा पाण्डो हा महाराज क्वासि किं समुपेक्षसे। पुत्रान् विवास्यतः साधूनरिभि तनिर्जितान्॥
en: Alas Pandu! Alas, lord where are you? How could you see your good children sent into exile thus persecuted by gambling?

sa: एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं निखिलेन युधिष्ठिर। पृष्टवानसि यं तात धर्मं धर्मभृतां वर॥
en: O Yudhishthira, O child, O foremost of virtuous men, I have thus told you in detail all that you asked me:

sa: द्विस्तीर्थानि मया पूर्वं दृष्टानि कुरुनन्दन। इदं तृतीयं द्रक्ष्यामि तान्येव भवता सह॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, I have seen the Tirthas twice before. I shall for the third time see them with you.

sa: दान्तं यच्च सभामध्य आसनं रत्नभूषितम्। दृष्ट्वा कुशवृषी चेमा शोको मां प्रदहत्ययम्॥
en: Thinking of that ivory seat in your court crested with jewels and seeing this scat of Kusha grass grief assails me.

sa: लोमश उवाच विलप्यैवं बहुविधं भरद्वाजोऽदहत् सुतम्। सुसमिद्धं ततः पश्चात् प्रविवेश हुताशनम्॥
en: Lomasha said : Having thus variously lamented for his son, Bharadvaja cremated him and then he himself entered a blazing fire.

sa: चित्रसेनस्तथोवाच सखायं युधि विद्धि माम्। चित्रसेनमथालक्ष्य सखायं युधि दुर्बलम्॥ संजहारास्त्रमथ तत् प्रसृष्टं पाण्डवर्षभः। दृष्ट्वा तु पाण्डवाः सर्वे संहतास्त्रं धनंजयम्॥ संजह्वः प्रदुतानश्वाञ्छरवेगान् धनूंषि च।
en: Chitrasena thus spoke to him, “Behold, your friend is fighting with you." Seeing his friend weak in battle, that foremost of Pandavas withdrew his weapons. The Pandavas, seeing Arjuna withdraw his weapons, checked their flying horses and stopped their weapons and withdrew their bows.

sa: सर्प उवाच चातुर्वण्र्यं प्रमाणं च सत्यं च ब्रह्म चैव हि। शूद्रेष्वपि च सत्यं च दानमक्रोध एव च। आनृशंस्यमहिंसा च घृणा चैव युधिष्ठिर॥
en: The serpent said : O Yudhishthira, even in the Shudras are found truthfulness, charity, forgiveness, benevolence, mercy, kindness and knowledge of the Veda which promotes the welfare of the four orders, which is true and which is the guide in religious matters.

sa: किमर्थं च जगत् सर्वं शरीरस्थं तवानघ। कियन्तं च त्वया कालमिह स्थेयमरिदम॥
en: O sinless one, O chastiser of foes, why does the universe is within your body? How long will you stay here?

sa: तथा तु दृष्ट्वा तानश्वान् वहतो वातरंहसः। अयोध्याधिपतिः श्रीमान् विस्मयं परमं ययौ॥
en: The blessed king of Ayodhya, having seen these horses carrying him with the speed of winds, was struck with great astonishment.

sa: निकृत्या निकृतिप्रज्ञा हन्तव्या इति निश्चयः। न हि नैकृतिकं हत्वा निकृत्या पापमुच्यते॥
en: Undoubtedly the deceitful persons should be done away with deceitful means. Surely it is no sin. to destroy them by frauds.

sa: उत्तिष्ठ भगवन् क्षिप्रं प्रविश्याभ्यन्तरं गृहम्। द्रष्टुमर्हसि धर्मज्ञ मातरं पितरं च मे॥
en: O exalted one, arise, soon enter this inner apartment. O virtuous one, you should see (first) my father and my mother.

sa: देवानां संगमं तं तु विज्ञाय कुरुनन्दन। नारदः पुण्डरीकाक्षं सस्मार मनसा हरिम्॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, knowing that assembly was an assembly of the celestialss, Narada thought in his mind the lotus-eyed Hari.

sa: एष चापि मया जन्तुर्मंगरूपं समाश्रितः। राक्षसो निहतो घोरो हन्तुं मामिह चागतः॥
en: See, this great beast, this fearful Rakshasas, who came here in the form of an animal, has been killed by me.

sa: नासत्यौ च कथं ब्रह्मन् कृतवान् सोमपीथिनौ। एतत् सर्वं यथावृत्तमाख्यातु भगवान् मम॥
en: O Brahmana, why he made the Ashvins, the drinkers of Soma? O exalted one, narrate all this to me in detail.

sa: तपसस्तु फलं दृष्ट्वा सम्प्रवृद्धं तपो महत्। उद्धर्तुकामो मतिमान् पुत्रो जज्ञे पुरंदरः॥
en: When Tapa acquired great ascetic merit, an intelligent son, named Purandara was born to him to inherit all these ascetic merits.

sa: अनुज्ञातं तु मां राज्ञा विजने कश्चिदब्रवीत्। ऋतुपर्णस्य पुरुषो बाहुको नाम नामतः॥
en: When I was dismissed by the king, some person in the service of Rituparna, Bahuka by name, told me in private.

sa: चक्रे तेन स संग्राम सहदेवेन भारत। स तमाजौ विनिर्जित्य दक्षिणाभिमुखो ययौ॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, he fought a battle with Sahadeva, but he (Sahadeva) defeated him and then marched towards the south.

sa: ततः शक्रोऽब्रवीत् पार्थं कृतास्त्रं काल आगते। नृत्यं गीतं च कौन्तेय चित्रसेनादवाप्नुहि॥
en: When the proper time came, Shakra (Indra) said to Partha (Arjuna), “O son of Kunti, iearn from Chitrasena singing and dancing.

sa: ततो दशसु मासेषु सोमकस्य विशाम्पते। जज्ञे पुत्रशतं पूर्ण तासु सर्वासु भारत॥
en: O king, O descendant of Bharata, at the end of the tenth month, full one hundred sons were born to Somaka.

sa: तत्र मासं वसेद्धीरो नैमिषे तीर्थतत्परः। पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि तानि तीर्थानि नैमिषे॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, the heroic pilgrim should live in Naimisha for one month; for all the Tirthas are in Naimisha.

sa: इच्छतः सा हि सिंहस्य भीष्म जीवत्यसंशयम्। तद्वत् त्वमप्यधर्मिष्ठ सदा वाचः प्रभाषसे॥
en: O Bhishma, that bird surely lived at the pleasure of the lion. O sinful wretch, you always speak like that bird.

sa: अंशुमन्तं च सम्पूज्य समापयत तं क्रतुम्। समाप्तयज्ञः सगरो देवैः सर्वैः सभाजितः॥
en: He praised and honoured Anshuman and completed his sacrifice. When the sacrifice was completed, Sagara was greeted by all the celestials.

sa: ततो मां प्रहसन् राजन् मातलि: प्रत्यभाषत। नैतदर्जुन देवेषु त्वयि वीर्यं यदीक्ष्यते॥
en: Then, O king, Matali addressed me with a smile "the prowess displayed by you cannot be seen even among the gods.”

sa: दमयन्ती तु शुश्राव रथघोषं नलस्य तम्। यथा मेघस्य नदतो गम्भीरं जलदागमे॥
en: Damayanti also heard the rattle of Nala's car, which was like the sound of the deeply rumbling clouds during the rains.

sa: क्रुद्धः पापं नरः कुर्यात् क्रुद्धो हन्याद् गुरूनपि। क्रुद्धः परुषया वाचा श्रेयसोऽप्यवमन्यते॥
en: The angry man commits a sin; the angry man murders his preceptor; the angry man insults his elders with harsh words.

sa: श्वेतं गिरि प्रवेक्ष्यामो मन्दरं चैव पर्वतम्। यत्र माणिवरो यक्षः कुबेरचैव यक्षराट्॥
en: We shall now ascend Shveta Giri and the Mandara mountain, where dwell Manivadra, Yaksha and Kubera, the king of the Yakshas.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु भीमेन हनूमान् प्लवगोत्तमः। प्रत्युवाच ततो वाक्यं स्निग्धगम्भीरया गिरा॥
en: Vaishampayana said: Having been thus addressed by Bhima, that chief of monkeys, Hanuman replied in affectionate words and in solemn accents.

sa: दीक्षितः स तु धर्मात्मा धर्मराजो युधिष्ठरः। जगाम यज्ञायतनं वृतो विप्रैः सहस्रशः॥
en: When the virtuous Dharmaraja Yudhishthira was installed in the sacrifice, he went to the sacrificial ground, surrounded by thousands of Brahmanas.

sa: धर्मार्थमेव ते राज्यधर्मार्थं जीवितं च ते। ब्राह्मणा गुरुवश्चैव जानन्त्यपि च देवताः॥
en: That your kingdom is for virtue and your life even is for virtue, is known by Brahmanas, superiors and even celestials.

sa: यस्त्वां वां राजन् मया सार्धमजिनैः प्रतिवासितम्। वनं प्रस्थाप्य दुष्टात्मा नान्वतप्यत दुर्मतिः॥
en: For, that vicious-minded one, O king, having sent you along with me to the forest clad in deer-skin, feels no mortification.

sa: विभजन् सर्वभूतानामायुः कर्म च भारत। अहोरात्रं कलाः काष्ठाः सृजत्येष सदा विभुः॥
en: O Bharata, the lord (sun), always imparting life and motion to all living creatures, creates day and night, Kala and Kashtha.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच युधिष्ठिरस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य दुरात्मनः। आचचक्षे ततः सर्वं गोत्रनामादि भारत॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O descendant of Bharata, having heard the words of that wretch, Yudhishthira told him his name and lineage.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा तु राजानं कर्णः शकुनिना सह। तूष्णीम्बभूवतुरुभौ वाक्यान्ते जनमेजय॥
en: Vaishampayana said: O Janamejaya, having thus spoken to the king, Shakuni and Karna when their speech was over both became silent.

sa: सायं प्रातः स्मरेद् यस्तु पुष्कराणि कृताञ्जलिः॥ उपस्पृष्टं भवेत् तेन सर्वतीर्थेषु भारत।
en: O descendant of Bharata, he who thinks of Pushkara, morning and evening with joined hands, practically bathes in all the Tirthas.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो वैतरणी सर्वे पाण्डवा द्रौपदी तथा। अवतीर्य महाभागास्तर्पयांचक्रिरे पितॄन्।॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thereupon all the highly exalted Pandavas with Draupadi descended to the Vaitarani and offered oblations to the Pitris.

sa: स विशीर्णोऽपतच्छैलो भृशमार्तस्वरान् रुवन्। तस्मिन् निपतिते त्वन्ये नेदुः शैला भृशं तदा॥
en: The Krauncha hill, being fearfully wounded, fell down uttering terrible groans. Seeing him fallen, the other hills also began to scream.

sa: आलक्ष्याश्चैव पुरुषाः कुले जाता महागुणाः। महाघोराणि कर्माणि कृत्वा लज्जन्ति वै द्विज॥
en: Men of noble birth and great accomplishment perpetrate wicked acts in defiance of all and they are not ashamed of it.

sa: स तेजस्वी तथा तेन भुजगेन वशीकृतः। विस्फुरन् शनकैर्भीमो न शशाक विचेष्टितुम्॥
en: Thus subdued by the snake, even that energetic man trembled slowly and was unable to make any effort (to extricate himself).

sa: मुदितश्च जनः सर्वः स्वधर्मेषु व्यवस्थितः। ता: प्रजा मुदिताः सर्वा दृष्टवा बलनिषूदनः॥
en: Adhering to the duties of their own order, people became very happy. Having seen all people happy, the slayer of Bala,

sa: प्रादुरासन् महाकायास्तस्योद्यानस्य रक्षिणः। ते दृष्ट्वाधर्मराजानं महर्षि चापि लोमशम्॥ विनयेन नताः सर्वे प्रणिपत्य च भारत॥ सान्त्विताधर्मराजेन प्रसेदुः क्षणदाचराः। विदिताश्च कुबेरस्य तत्र ते कुरुपुङ्गवाः॥
en: Seeing Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira) and the great Rishi Lomasha and Nakula and Sahadeva and also the other foremost of Brahmanas, They all, O descendent of Bharata, bowed down their heads to them in humility. Being pacified by Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira) the Rakshasas were gratified.

sa: येषां बालाश्च वृद्धाश्च पितृपैतामहीं धुरम्। उद्वहन्ति न सीदन्ति तेभ्यो वै स्पृहयाम्यहम्॥
en: My heart longs for those in whose family persons young and old diligently bear the, ancestral burthens without languishing under them.

sa: दृष्ट्वा गर्भमनुप्राप्तां भार्यो स च महानृषिः। उवाच तां सत्यवती दुर्मना भृगुसत्तमः॥
en: Finding his wife quick with child, that great Rishi, the descendant of Bhrigu, became pleased at heart, and addressing her, said:

sa: एवं प्रकृतितः सर्वे प्रवर्तन्ते शरीरिणः। निवर्तन्ते निवृत्तौ च स्वर्गं चैवोपयान्ति च॥
en: Embodied creatures perform various actions on account of attributes. When they abstain therefrom, they acquire liberation. Some again go to heaven.

sa: यत्र यत्रानुमानेऽस्मिन् कृतं भावयतोऽपि च। नान्यो जीवः शरीरस्य नास्तिकानां मते स्थितः॥
en: Do not reason on inference only whatever may be the subject. There is nothing else called individual soul than this body.

sa: सुखं दान्तः प्रस्वपिति सुखं च प्रतिबुद्ध्यते। सुखं लोके विपर्येति मनश्चास्य प्रसीदति॥
en: One who is self-controlled sleeps happily and wakes happily. He lives happily in the world and his mind always remains cheerful

sa: तमतिक्रम्य विधिना प्रष्टुमर्हसि कासितम्। स ते परमकं धर्मं न मिथ्या दर्शयिष्यति॥
en: Going there, you should put to him the questions you wish. He will show you truly what the highest religion is.

sa: तत्सर्वं निखिलेनाद्य कथयिष्यामि तेऽनघ। मयाऽपि च यथा दृष्टो देवदेवः पुरा विभो॥
en: I shall, O sinless one, tell you fully all that I succeeded in obtaining from that god of gods, viz., Maheshvara.

sa: ततस्तु स्वनमासाद्य वायुः सम्भवमात्मनः। अधश्चोर्ध्वं च तिर्यक् च दोधवीति दिशो दश॥
en: Obtaining its own attribute, viz., sound the Wind begins to move upwards and downwards and transversely along all the ten points.

sa: राजा मित्रसहश्चापि वसिष्ठाय महात्मने। मदयन्तीं प्रियां दत्त्वा तया सह दिवं गतः॥
en: Having given his own dear wife Mayadanti to the great Vasistha, King Mitrasaha ascenued to heaven with that wife of his.

sa: तेषु विश्वमिदं भूतं सर्वं च जगदाहितम्। तेषां माहात्म्यभावस्य सदृशं नास्ति किंचन।॥
en: This world of beings depends upon these, and in them exist this whole universe. There is nothing equal to their greatness.

sa: ततोऽथ वरदो देवो ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः। असृजत् स ततो लोकान् कृत्स्नान् स्थावरजङ्गमान्॥
en: After this, the boon-giving Brahman, the Grandfather of the worlds, created the different worlds with all their mobile and immobile creatures.

sa: यदि नाम जन्म भूयो अवति मदीयैः पुनर्दोषैः। तस्मिंस्तस्मिञ्जन्मनि भवे भवेन्मेऽक्षया भक्तिः॥
en: If on account of any faults, I come by rebirths, I shall, in those new births, devote myself solely to Bhava.

sa: तस्मिन् नष्टे शरीराग्नौ ततो देहमचेतनम्। पतितं याति भूमित्वमयनं तस्य हि क्षितिः॥
en: With the extinction of heat, the body itself loses aniination. Falling down, it it is metamorphosed into earth, its ultimate destination.

sa: परमाणुभूता भूत्वा तु तं देवं प्रविशन्त्युत। तस्मादपि च निर्मुक्ता अनिरुद्धतनौ स्थिताः॥
en: Reduced into invisible atoms, they then enter into Narayana. Passing out from him also, they enter into the form of Aniruddha.

sa: प्रत्यक्षं चैव ते कृष्ण पश्य सिद्धान् व्यवस्थितान्। ऋषीन् विद्याधरान् यक्षान् गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा॥
en: See, O Krishna, before your eyes, these Siddhas living here and these Rishis and Vidyadharas and Yakshas and Gandharvas and Apsaras.

sa: त्वत्तो जातानि भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च। त्वया सृष्टमिदं कृत्स्नं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्॥
en: All beings, mobile and immobile, have originated from you. You have created this world with all its mobile and immobile creations.

sa: यदा वेदश्रुतिर्नष्टा मया प्रत्याहृता पुनः। सवेदाः सश्रुतीकाश्च कृताः पूर्वं कृते युगे॥
en: When the Vedas disappeared from the world, I brought them back. The Vedas, were re-created by me in the Krita age.

sa: बहुव्याक्षेपयुक्तानि त्वामाह वचनानि सः। न युक्तानि मया वायो तानि वक्तुं तवाग्रतः॥
en: He spoke many insulting words against yourself. It is not meet, O Wind, that I should repeat them in your hearing.

sa: ऋषयश्च हि देवाश्च गन्धर्वाश्च महौजसः। वियुक्ता ब्रह्मघोषेण न भ्राजन्ते यथा पुरा॥
en: The Rishis, the gods, and the Gandharvas, too, no longer shine as before on account of being deprived of Vedic sound.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कच्चित् पितामहेनासीच्छुतं वा दृष्टमेव च। कच्चिन्मो मृतो राजन् पुनरुज्जीवितोऽभवत्॥
en: Yudhishthira said Have you, O grandfather, ever seen or heard of any mortal restored to life after having met with death.

sa: तस्यैव च प्रसादेन प्रादुर्भूतं महामुने। ज्ञानं दिव्यं ममापीदं तेनासि विदितो मम॥
en: O great ascetic, through the grace of your father, I have acquired omniscience, and hence I have succeeded in knowing you.

sa: तत्स्वभावोऽपरो दृष्टो विसर्गः कर्मणस्तथा॥ न जायते तु नृपते कंचित् कालमयं पुनः।
en: Individual Soul after dissolution of the body is inhabited, does not, O king, take birth in a different body at once.

sa: एवंविधेन तपसा तस्य भक्त्या च भारत। महेश्वरः प्रसन्नात्मा चकार मनसा मतिम्॥
en: Pleased with such penances and such devotion, O Bharata, of the Rishi, the great God resolved to grant him his wish.

sa: यस्मिन् न विभ्रमाः केचिद् दृश्यन्ते मनुजर्षभ। गुणाश्च यस्मिन् बहवो दोषहानिश्च केवला॥
en: In that doctrine, O king no errors are seen. Its merits are manifold. In fact, there is no fault in it.

sa: शक्रस्योद्रम्य चरणं प्रस्थितो जनमेजयः। द्विजस्त्रीणां वधं कृत्वा किं दैवेन न वारितः॥
en: Was not Janamejaya, who followed the footprints of Shakra, for slaying a Brahmana woman, checked and put down by the gods?.

sa: शौचेन लभते विप्रः क्षत्रियो विक्रमेण तु। वैश्यः पुरुषकारेण शूद्रः शुश्रूषया श्रियम्॥
en: The Brahmana acquires prosperity by holy living, the Kshatriya by prowess, the Vaishya by manly exertion, and the Shudra by service.

sa: उत्सृज्य चैव तं गर्भ नद्यास्तीरे जगाम सा। अप्सरा मेनका ब्रह्मन्निर्दया निरपत्रपा॥
en: And, O Brahmana, the cruel and shameless Apsara Menaka, after leaving the child on the banks of the river, went away.

sa: श्येन उवाच आहारात् सर्वभूतानि सम्भवन्ति महीपते। आहारेण विवर्धन्ते तेन जीवन्ति जन्तवः॥
en: The Hawk said : O ruler of earth, all creatures exist on food. The animals are nourished and sustained by food.

sa: संस्कृतं प्रसवं याति स्वल्पमन्नं चतुर्विधम्। अक्षय्यं वर्धते चान्नं तेन भोजयते द्विजान्॥
en: The food, however little that was cooked, becoming four kinds increased and become inexhaustible. Who them he (Yudhishthira) fed the Brahman.

sa: पश्य चैतान् महीपालांस्त्वत्तो वृद्धतरान् बहून्। मृष्यन्ते चार्हणां कृष्णे तद्वत् त्वं क्षन्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Look, these many kings, who are all older than you, approve the worship offered to Krishna. You should also approve it.

sa: गते हि हरिशार्दूल पुनः सम्प्राप्तये त्वयि। प्राणेष्वपि न विश्वासो मम वानरपुङ्गव॥
en: You will go, O powerful monkey; but ere you return, it is, O foremost of monkeys, doubtful whether I shall live.

sa: तं कर्णः प्रतिविव्याध शतेन नतपर्वणाम्। सज्यं चास्य धनुः शीघ्रं चिच्छेद लघुहस्तवत्॥
en: Karna (also) pierced him in return with a hundred straight arrows and then with great light-handedness quickly cut-off his stringed bow.

sa: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं कुरूणां पाण्डवैः सह। निवृत्तानां महाराज मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम्॥
en: Then, O king, an encounter which took place between the Pandavas and the Kurus who were determined upon meeting with death.

sa: शिखण्डी तं च विव्याध भरतानां पितामहम्। स्त्रीमयं मनसा ध्यात्वा नास्मै प्राहरदच्युतः॥
en: Then Shikhandin pierced the grand father of the Bharatas, but the latter of undeteriorating renown struck him not, remembering his femininity.

sa: नित्यं यस्तु सतो रक्षेदसतश्च निवर्तयेत्। स एव राजा कर्तव्यस्तेन सर्वमिदं धृतम्॥
en: That person who always protects the good and checks the wicked, deserves to become a king and to govern the world.'

sa: द्रोणः शरैरसम्भ्रान्तो ज्यां विच्छेदाशु वीर्यवान्। विव्याध च हयानस्य ध्वजं सारथिमेव च॥
en: The undaunted Drona endued with prowess, cut-off with his arrows the formers string; he also pierced his horses, standards and charioteer.

sa: दिव्येन चक्षुषा पश्यन् मनसा तद्गतेन च। सर्वप्राणभृतां भावं स तत्र समबुध्यत॥
en: Capable of seeing the heart of everyone with his spiritual vision and desirous of doing the same, the sage came there.

sa: सुवर्णस्य विशुद्धस्य सुवर्णं यः प्रयच्छति॥ सुवर्णानां शतं तेन दत्तं भवति शाश्वतम्।
en: He who gives away eighty Ratis of pure gold, obtains the everlasting fruit of giving away one hundred pieces of gold.

sa: सम्ममर्द च तत् सैन्यं पिता देवव्रतस्तव। धान्यानामिव लूनानां प्रकरं गोगणा इव॥
en: Then your father Devavrata crushed that army like a herd of heifer grinding (under their tread) a heap of paddy sheaves.

sa: ततः स शरवर्षाणि प्रत्यमित्रान् प्रति प्रभुः। ववर्ष धनुषा पार्थो वर्षाणीव पुरंदरः॥
en: Like Purandara pouring rain, the powerful Arjuna then, with that bow of his, poured incessant showers of arrows on his enemies.

sa: तं तु दृष्ट्वा हतं शूरमश्वत्थामा महारथः। अभ्यधावत वेगेन शैनेयं प्रति संयुगे॥
en: The mighty car-warrior Ashvatthama witnessing the slaughter of that hero, rushed impetuously, O descendant of Bharata, against the grandson of Shini.

sa: यदि चेच्छसि संग्रामे द्रष्टुमेतान् विशाम्पते। चक्षुर्ददानि ते पुत्र युद्धं तत्र निशामय॥
en: O king, O child, if you wish to see them in battle, I shall bestow on you sight. Behold the battle.

sa: इत्येवमुक्त्वा राजानः सहसा दुद्रुबुद्धिजान्। ततः कर्णो महातेजा जिष्णुं प्रति ययौ रणे॥
en: Saying this, the monarchs at once rushed upon the Brahmanas and the greatly powerful Karna rushed against Jishnu (Arjuna) to fight.

sa: अथैनं सात्यकिः क्रुद्धः पञ्चभिर्निशितैः शरैः। विव्याध हृदये तस्य प्रास्रवत् तस्य शोणितम्॥
en: Inflamed with wrath, Satyaki, then, pierced him in the heart with five sharpened arrows. (Thus struck) his blood began to flow.

sa: एवमिन्द्रस्य भवने पञ्च वर्षाणि भारत। उषितानि मया राजन् स्मरता द्यूतजं कलिम्॥
en: Thus, O monarch, remembering the troubles brought on (us) by gambling I passed (these) five years in the abode of Indra.
